//! One-child historical extraction moves the existing asset home atomically.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#20-visible-rollback-views-roll — deterministic identities, no upload or second home.
use super::*;
#[path = "extraction_each.rs"]
mod each;
use crate::{
    meter::{Ceilings, Cut, Meter},
    schema::{ColumnType, Extraction},
};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
fn refuse(s: impl Into<String>) -> RuntimeError {
    RuntimeError::Structural {
        code: "E_ADOPT",
        message: s.into(),
    }
}
fn asset(k: &ColumnType) -> bool {
    match k {
        ColumnType::Optional(k)
        | ColumnType::List { of: k, .. }
        | ColumnType::ListRange { of: k, .. } => asset(k),
        ColumnType::Image { .. } | ColumnType::File { .. } | ColumnType::Video { .. } => true,
        _ => false,
    }
}
fn fields(row: &mut Value) -> Result<&mut crate::value::ObjectFields, RuntimeError> {
    match row {
        Value::Row(f) | Value::Map(f) => Ok(f),
        _ => Err(refuse("invalid extraction row")),
    }
}
fn key(tx:&Tx<'_>,e:&Extraction)->Result<String,RuntimeError>{
    let parent=tx.num(&e.parent)?;let child=tx.num(&e.child)?;
    let aliases:bool=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name='_asset_column_renames')",[],|r|r.get(0))?;
    let origin=|t:i64,c:&str|->Result<String,RuntimeError>{
        if !aliases{return Ok(c.into())}
        Ok(tx.conn().query_row("SELECT origin FROM _asset_column_renames WHERE t=?1 AND name=?2",params![t,c],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?.unwrap_or_else(||c.into()))
    };
    let fields=e.fields.iter().map(|(dest,source)|Ok((origin(child,dest)?,origin(parent,source)?))).collect::<Result<BTreeMap<_,_>,RuntimeError>>()?;
    let base=(parent,child,origin(child,&e.reference)?,fields);
    Ok(if e.each {crate::value::digest(&("each-v1",base))}else{crate::value::digest(&base)})
}
fn exists(tx: &Tx<'_>) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    Ok(tx.conn().query_row(
        "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name='_extraction_rows')",
        [],
        |r| r.get(0),
    )?)
}
fn load(tx: &Tx<'_>, t: i64, id: &str) -> Result<Option<Value>, RuntimeError> {
    let bytes: Option<i64> = tx
        .conn()
        .query_row(
            "SELECT octet_length(data) FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",
            params![t, id],
            |r| r.get(0),
        )
        .optional()?;
    let Some(bytes) = bytes else { return Ok(None) };
    Meter::new(Ceilings::job(), Cut::Abort).heap(
        (bytes.max(0) as u64)
            .saturating_mul(64)
            .saturating_add(8192),
    )?;
    let text: String = tx.conn().query_row(
        "SELECT data FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",
        params![t, id],
        |r| r.get(0),
    )?;
    serde_json::from_str(&text)
        .map(Some)
        .map_err(|e| refuse(e.to_string()))
}
fn write(tx: &Tx<'_>, t: i64, id: &str, row: &Value) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO r(t,id,data) VALUES(?1,?2,?3) ON CONFLICT(t,id) DO UPDATE SET data=excluded.data",params![t,id,canonical_json(row)])?;
    Ok(())
}
fn value(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    t: i64,
    id: &str,
    row: &Value,
    c: &str,
) -> Result<Option<Value>, RuntimeError> {
    if let Ok(v) = row.field(c) {
        return Ok(Some(v.clone()));
    }
    let text: Option<String> = tx
        .conn()
        .query_row(
            "SELECT data FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",
            params![t, id, c],
            |r| r.get(0),
        )
        .optional()?;
    text.map(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).map_err(|e| refuse(e.to_string())))
        .transpose()
}
fn transfer(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    v: &Value,
    from: (&str, &str, &str),
    to: (&str, &str, &str),
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    if let Value::Array(vs) = v {
        for v in vs {
            transfer(tx, v, from, to)?;
        }
        return Ok(());
    }
    if v == &Value::Null {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let id = crate::assets::asset_id(Some(v))
        .ok_or_else(|| refuse("extraction asset has no typed ledger id"))?;
    let bytes:Option<i64>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT bytes FROM _assets WHERE id=?1 AND home_table=?2 AND home_id=?3 AND home_column=?4 AND released_at IS NULL",params![id,from.0,from.1,from.2],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
    let bytes = bytes.ok_or_else(|| {
        refuse(format!(
            "extraction asset {id} has no live source home; never claim or duplicate it"
        ))
    })?;
    let root = tx
        .meta("activation_asset_root")?
        .ok_or_else(|| refuse("extraction requires activation asset custody"))?;
    if id.is_empty()
        || !id
            .bytes()
            .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'-' || b == b'_')
    {
        return Err(refuse("invalid extraction asset id"));
    }
    let path = std::path::Path::new(&root).join(id);
    let meta = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&path)
        .map_err(|_| refuse(format!("extraction asset {id} bytes are unavailable")))?;
    if !meta.is_file() || meta.len() != bytes as u64 {
        return Err(refuse(format!(
            "extraction asset {id} byte length disagrees with its ledger"
        )));
    }
    if from != to {
    tx.conn().execute(
        "UPDATE _assets SET home_table=?2,home_id=?3,home_column=?4 WHERE id=?1",
        params![id, to.0, to.1, to.2],
    )?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
pub(super) fn transition(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    next: &Schema,
    previous: Option<&Schema>,
    sources: &BTreeMap<String, Table>,
    report: &mut super::adoption_report::AdoptionReport,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    if next.extractions.is_empty() && previous.is_none_or(|s| s.extractions.is_empty()) {
        return Ok(());
    }
    tx.conn().execute_batch("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _extraction_rows(definition TEXT NOT NULL,parent_t INTEGER NOT NULL,parent_id TEXT NOT NULL,child_t INTEGER NOT NULL,child_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(definition,parent_t,parent_id),UNIQUE(definition,child_t,child_id)) WITHOUT ROWID;")?;
    tx.conn().execute_batch("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _extraction_cells(definition TEXT NOT NULL,parent_t INTEGER NOT NULL,parent_id TEXT NOT NULL,column_name TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(definition,parent_t,parent_id,column_name)) WITHOUT ROWID;")?;
    tx.conn().execute_batch("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _extraction_active(child_t INTEGER NOT NULL,definition TEXT NOT NULL,parent_name TEXT NOT NULL,reference_column TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(child_t,definition)) WITHOUT ROWID; DELETE FROM _extraction_active;")?;
    for e in &next.extractions {
        tx.conn().execute(
            "INSERT INTO _extraction_active VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4)",
            params![tx.num(&e.child)?, key(tx,e)?, e.parent, e.reference],
        )?;
    }
    tx.set_meta("version", super::table_renames::VERSION)?;
    for e in previous
        .into_iter()
        .flat_map(|s| &s.extractions)
        .filter(|e| !next.extractions.contains(e))
    {
        let Some(parent) = next.table(&e.parent) else {
            continue;
        };
        let child = &previous.unwrap().tables[&e.child];
        let pt = tx.num(&e.parent)?;
        let ct = tx.num(&e.child)?;
        let key = key(tx,e)?;
        let mut count = 0;
        let inherited = child
            .through
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|t| t.reference == e.reference && t.parent == e.parent);
        let current_parent = &previous.unwrap().tables[&e.parent];
        if parent.rules.read != crate::schema::RuleExpr::Deny
            && ((inherited && parent.rules.read != current_parent.rules.read)
                || (!inherited && parent.rules.read != child.rules.read))
        {
            return Err(refuse(
                "reverse extraction would broaden the current asset audience; preserve current read policy in an authored bridge",
            ));
        }
        for (dest, source) in &e.fields {
            if asset(&child.columns[dest])
                && parent.columns.contains_key(source)
                && parent.column_reads.get(source) != child.column_reads.get(dest)
            {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "reverse extraction would change the asset column audience; retain its current gate in a bridge",
                ));
            }
        }
        if e.each { each::backward(tx,e,parent,current_parent,child,&key,report)?; continue; }
        super::activation::walk(tx, pt, |id, mut row| {
            let saved:Option<String>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT child_id FROM _extraction_rows WHERE definition=?1 AND parent_t=?2 AND parent_id=?3",params![key,pt,id],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
            let child_id = if let Some(id) = saved {
                id
            } else {
                let mut found = Vec::new();
                super::activation::walk(tx, ct, |child_id, child| {
                    if child.field(&e.reference) == Ok(&Value::Id(id.into())) {
                        if found.len() < 2 {
                            found.push(child_id.to_owned());
                        }
                    }
                    Ok(())
                })?;
                if found.len() > 1 {
                    return Err(refuse(format!(
                        "extraction {} parent {id}: several child rows compete for the old asset; declare a truthful bridge",
                        e.child
                    )));
                }
                let Some(child) = found.pop() else {
                    return Ok(());
                };
                child
            };
            let Some(mut image) = load(tx, ct, &child_id)? else {
                return Err(refuse(format!(
                    "extraction child {}/{child_id} was deleted; old asset has no truthful representation",
                    e.child
                )));
            };
            if image.field(&e.reference) != Ok(&Value::Id(id.into())) {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "extraction child reference changed; refusing to rebind its parent lifetime",
                ));
            }
            let anchored:bool=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3 AND parent_t=?4 AND parent_id=?5 AND invalid=0)",params![ct,child_id,format!("$extract:{key}"),pt,id],|r|r.get(0))?;
            if !anchored {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "extraction child lacks valid parent-lifetime evidence; refusing deletion/id reuse or retrospective recapture",
                ));
            }
            for (destination, source) in &e.fields {
                let kind = &child.columns[destination];
                if !asset(kind) {
                    if row.field(source).ok() != image.field(destination).ok() {
                        return Err(refuse(
                            "extraction immutable scalar copies disagree with the current parent",
                        ));
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                if !parent.columns.contains_key(source) {
                    continue;
                }
                if parent.columns[source] != *kind {
                    return Err(refuse("reverse extraction requires identical asset types"));
                }
                let v = image.field(destination)?.clone();
                retain_cell(tx, &key, pt, id, source, &v)?;
                transfer(
                    tx,
                    &v,
                    (&e.child, &child_id, destination),
                    (&e.parent, id, source),
                )?;
                fields(&mut row)?.insert(source.clone(), v);
                fields(&mut image)?.remove(destination);
                tx.conn().execute(
                    "DELETE FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",
                    params![pt, id, source],
                )?;
            }
            write(tx, pt, id, &row)?;
            write(tx, ct, &child_id, &image)?;
            tx.conn().execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _extraction_rows VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5)",
                params![key, pt, id, ct, child_id],
            )?;
            count += 1;
            Ok(())
        })?;
        report.backfills.push(format!(
            "extract {}: moved asset homes back for {count} parent rows",
            e.child
        ));
    }
    for e in next
        .extractions
        .iter()
        .filter(|e| previous.is_none_or(|s| !s.extractions.contains(e)))
    {
        e.admit(next).map_err(refuse)?;
        let parent = sources.get(&e.parent).unwrap_or(&next.tables[&e.parent]);
        let child = &next.tables[&e.child];
        let pt = tx.num(&e.parent)?;
        let ct = tx.num(&e.child)?;
        let key = key(tx,e)?;
        let mut count = 0;
        let inherited = child
            .through
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|t| t.reference == e.reference && t.parent == e.parent);
        let source_read = &parent.rules.read;
        if inherited {
            if next.tables[&e.parent].rules.read != *source_read {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "asset extraction cannot broaden the inherited parent read policy; stage an explicit policy change separately",
                ));
            }
        } else if child.rules.read != crate::schema::RuleExpr::Deny {
            if child.rules.read != *source_read
                || source_read.any_term(&|term| {
                    matches!(
                        term,
                        crate::schema::RuleTerm::Field(_)
                            | crate::schema::RuleTerm::OldField(_)
                            | crate::schema::RuleTerm::NextField(_)
                            | crate::schema::RuleTerm::Reference { .. }
                            | crate::schema::RuleTerm::ReferenceChain { .. }
                    )
                })
            {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "asset extraction requires read through its parent for row-dependent privacy; the destination cannot broaden the source audience",
                ));
            }
        }
        for (dest, source) in &e.fields {
            let parent_gate = parent.column_reads.get(source);
            if parent_gate.is_some() && child.column_reads.get(dest) != parent_gate {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "asset extraction must preserve the source column's read policy",
                ));
            }
        }
        let populated: bool =
            tx.conn()
                .query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE t=?1)", [pt], |r| {
                    r.get(0)
                })?;
        let consumed_each=e.each && !parent.columns.contains_key(each::source(e,child));
        // @ref LLP 3000.000.000.002#10-wave-25-day-two-friction-dx8 — definition custody survives an empty parent population; every resumed child still needs its original anchor.
        let resume_each=consumed_each && each::known(tx,&key)?;
        if consumed_each && !resume_each {
            let child_history:bool=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE t=?1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_rows WHERE t=?1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1)",[ct],|r|r.get(0))?;
            if populated || child_history {return Err(refuse("extract each source list is absent and no successfully applied extraction owns this suspended definition; preserve independent child history in an authored bridge"));}
        }
        for (dest, source) in e.fields.iter().filter(|_| populated) {
            if resume_each && asset(&child.columns[dest]) {continue;}
            let kind = parent.columns.get(source).ok_or_else(|| {
                refuse(format!("extraction source {}.{source} is absent", e.parent))
            })?;
            let same = if e.each && asset(&child.columns[dest]) {each::item_type(kind)==Some(&child.columns[dest])} else {kind == &child.columns[dest]};
            if !same
                || parent.engine_field(source)
                || parent.maintained.contains_key(source)
                || parent.written_by.contains_key(source)
            {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "extraction requires identical authoritative source and destination types",
                ));
            }
            if asset(kind) && next.tables[&e.parent].columns.contains_key(source) {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "extraction must remove the source asset column; one asset cannot have two active homes",
                ));
            }
            if !asset(kind)&&(!parent.constraints.iter().any(|c|matches!(c,crate::schema::Constraint::Immutable{fields} if fields.contains(source)))||matches!(kind,ColumnType::Ref{..}|ColumnType::Optional(_))){return Err(refuse("extraction scalar copies require immutable source fields without reference/captured authority"))}
        }
        if e.each { if resume_each {each::resume(tx,e,parent,child,&key,report)?;}else{each::forward(tx,e,parent,child,&key,report)?;} continue; }
        super::activation::walk(tx, pt, |id, mut row| {
            let saved:Option<String>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT child_id FROM _extraction_rows WHERE definition=?1 AND parent_t=?2 AND parent_id=?3",params![key,pt,id],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
            let child_id = saved.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| id.to_owned());
            let present = load(tx, ct, &child_id)?;
            let independent:bool=if saved.is_none(){tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _extraction_rows WHERE child_t=?1 AND child_id=?2)",params![ct,child_id],|r|r.get(0))?}else{false};
            if saved.is_none() && (present.is_some()||independent) {
                return Err(refuse(format!(
                    "extraction destination {}/{child_id} already has independent history",
                    e.child
                )));
            }
            if saved.is_some(){
                let anchored:bool=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3 AND parent_t=?4 AND parent_id=?5 AND invalid=0)",params![ct,child_id,format!("$extract:{key}"),pt,id],|r|r.get(0))?;
                if present.is_none()||!anchored{return Err(refuse("returning extraction lacks its receipt-owned child or valid parent-lifetime evidence; never recreate pruned/deleted history"))}
            }
            let mut image = present.unwrap_or_else(|| {
                Value::Row(
                    BTreeMap::from([
                        ("id".into(), Value::Id(child_id.clone())),
                        (e.reference.clone(), Value::Id(id.into())),
                    ])
                    .into(),
                )
            });
            if image.field(&e.reference) != Ok(&Value::Id(id.into())) {
                return Err(refuse("extraction cannot rebind a child parent"));
            }
            for (destination, source) in &e.fields {
                let kind = &child.columns[destination];
                let Some(v) = value(tx, pt, id, &row, source)? else {
                    continue;
                };
                if asset(kind) {
                    if image.field(destination).is_ok_and(|old| old != &v) {
                        return Err(refuse(
                            "extraction destination asset conflicts with its source",
                        ));
                    }
                    retain_cell(tx, &key, pt, id, source, &v)?;
                    transfer(
                        tx,
                        &v,
                        (&e.parent, id, source),
                        (&e.child, &child_id, destination),
                    )?;
                    fields(&mut image)?.insert(destination.clone(), v);
                    fields(&mut row)?.remove(source);
                    tx.conn().execute(
                        "DELETE FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",
                        params![pt, id, source],
                    )?;
                } else if saved.is_none() {
                    fields(&mut image)?.insert(destination.clone(), v);
                } else if image.field(destination).ok() != Some(&v) {
                    return Err(refuse(
                        "extraction immutable scalar copies disagree with the returning parent",
                    ));
                }
            }
            crate::schema::materialize_optional_fields(&mut image, child);
            write(tx, pt, id, &row)?;
            write(tx, ct, &child_id, &image)?;
            tx.conn().execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _extraction_rows VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5)",
                params![key, pt, id, ct, child_id],
            )?;
            super::dormant::capture_refs(
                tx,
                ct,
                &child_id,
                &format!("$extract:{key}"),
                &ColumnType::Ref {
                    table: e.parent.clone(),
                },
                &Value::Id(id.into()),
            )?;
            count += 1;
            Ok(())
        })?;
        report.backfills.push(format!(
            "extract {}: prepared {count} child rows and moved existing asset homes",
            e.child
        ));
    }
    tx.set_meta("activation_population", "true")?;
    Ok(())
}
pub(super) fn delete(tx: &Tx<'_>, t: i64, id: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    if exists(tx)? {
        each::delete(tx,t,id)?;
        tx.conn().execute(
            "DELETE FROM _extraction_cells WHERE parent_t=?1 AND parent_id=?2",
            params![t, id],
        )?;
        tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _extraction_rows WHERE (parent_t=?1 AND parent_id=?2) OR (child_t=?1 AND child_id=?2)",params![t,id])?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn observe_write(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    t: i64,
    id: &str,
    row: &Value,
    old: Option<&Value>,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    if !exists(tx)? {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let active:Vec<(String,String,String)>=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT definition,parent_name,reference_column FROM _extraction_active WHERE child_t=?1")?.query_map([t],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?,r.get(2)?)))?.collect::<Result<_,_>>()?;
    for (key, parent, column) in active {
        let binding = format!("$extract:{key}");
        // @ref LLP 3000.000.000.002#10-wave-25-day-two-friction-dx8 — only birth or a real reference change can capture a parent lifetime; an asset edit cannot repair missing provenance.
        if old.is_some_and(|old| old.field(&column).ok() == row.field(&column).ok()) {
            continue;
        }
        if let Ok(value) = row.field(&column) {
            super::dormant::capture_refs(
                tx,
                t,
                id,
                &binding,
                &ColumnType::Ref { table: parent },
                value,
            )?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn retain_cell(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    key: &str,
    t: i64,
    id: &str,
    column: &str,
    value: &Value,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    let old: Option<String> = tx
        .conn()
        .query_row(
            "SELECT data FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",
            params![t, id, column],
            |r| r.get(0),
        )
        .optional()?;
    if let Some(old) = old {
        let old: Value = serde_json::from_str(&old).map_err(|e| refuse(e.to_string()))?;
        if &old != value {
            return Err(refuse(
                "extraction has a distinct retained source cell; preserve both meanings in an authored bridge",
            ));
        }
    }
    tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO _extraction_cells VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5) ON CONFLICT(definition,parent_t,parent_id,column_name) DO UPDATE SET data=excluded.data",params![key,t,id,column,canonical_json(value)])?;
    Ok(())
}

//! A bounded historical asset list becomes one receipt-owned child per element.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000.002#10-wave-25-day-two-friction-dx8 — stable element identities and current values round-trip without copying bytes or acquiring another home.
use super::*;
use crate::error::MeterKind;
use std::collections::BTreeSet;

pub(super) fn item_type(kind: &ColumnType) -> Option<&ColumnType> {
    match kind {
        ColumnType::Optional(kind) => item_type(kind),
        ColumnType::List { of, .. } | ColumnType::ListRange { of, .. } => Some(of),
        _ => None,
    }
}
fn setup(tx: &Tx<'_>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    tx.conn().execute_batch("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _extraction_each_rows(definition TEXT NOT NULL,parent_t INTEGER NOT NULL,parent_id TEXT NOT NULL,child_t INTEGER NOT NULL,child_id TEXT NOT NULL,asset_id TEXT NOT NULL,position INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(definition,child_t,child_id),UNIQUE(definition,parent_t,parent_id,asset_id)) WITHOUT ROWID; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _extraction_each_definitions(definition TEXT PRIMARY KEY) WITHOUT ROWID;")?;
    Ok(())
}
fn exists(tx: &Tx<'_>) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    Ok(tx.conn().query_row(
        "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name='_extraction_each_rows')",
        [],
        |r| r.get(0),
    )?)
}
pub(super) fn delete(tx: &Tx<'_>, t: i64, id: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    if exists(tx)? {
        tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _extraction_each_rows WHERE (parent_t=?1 AND parent_id=?2) OR (child_t=?1 AND child_id=?2)",params![t,id])?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn mapping<'a>(e: &'a Extraction, child: &Table) -> (&'a str, &'a str) {
    e.fields
        .iter()
        .find(|(c, _)| asset(&child.columns[*c]))
        .map(|(a, b)| (a.as_str(), b.as_str()))
        .expect("admitted each mapping")
}
fn asset_id(value: &Value) -> Result<String, RuntimeError> {
    crate::assets::asset_id(Some(value))
        .map(str::to_owned)
        .ok_or_else(|| refuse("extract each requires non-null typed asset list elements"))
}
fn anchored(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    ct: i64,
    child_id: &str,
    key: &str,
    pt: i64,
    parent_id: &str,
) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    Ok(tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3 AND parent_t=?4 AND parent_id=?5 AND invalid=0)",params![ct,child_id,format!("$extract:{key}"),pt,parent_id],|r|r.get(0))?)
}
fn remember(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    key: &str,
    pt: i64,
    id: &str,
    column: &str,
    v: &Value,
    meter: &mut Meter,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    meter.heap(v.retained_heap_bytes().saturating_mul(4).saturating_add(8192))?;
    let encoded = canonical_json(v);
    let conflicting:bool=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_values d WHERE d.t=?1 AND d.id=?2 AND d.column_name=?3 AND d.data!=?4 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _extraction_cells e WHERE e.definition=?5 AND e.parent_t=d.t AND e.parent_id=d.id AND e.column_name=d.column_name AND e.data=d.data))",params![pt,id,column,encoded,key],|r|r.get(0))?;
    if conflicting {
            return Err(refuse(
                "extract each has a conflicting retained source list; preserve both meanings in a bridge",
            ));
    }
    tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO _extraction_cells VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5) ON CONFLICT(definition,parent_t,parent_id,column_name) DO UPDATE SET data=excluded.data",params![key,pt,id,column,encoded])?;
    tx.conn().execute(
        "DELETE FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",
        params![pt, id, column],
    )?;
    Ok(())
}
fn save(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    key: &str,
    pt: i64,
    id: &str,
    ct: i64,
    child_id: &str,
    asset_id: &str,
    position: usize,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO _extraction_each_rows VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6,?7) ON CONFLICT(definition,child_t,child_id) DO UPDATE SET asset_id=excluded.asset_id,position=excluded.position",params![key,pt,id,ct,child_id,asset_id,position as i64])?;
    Ok(())
}

// A migration-owned null can remain in narrowed storage across old views.
// Reading it validates custody without restoring it into the active population.
fn receipt_image(tx: &Tx<'_>, ct: i64, id: &str, meter:&mut Meter) -> Result<Option<Value>, RuntimeError> {
    read_image(tx,ct,id,meter,true)
}
fn read_image(tx: &Tx<'_>, ct: i64, id: &str, meter:&mut Meter, dormant:bool) -> Result<Option<Value>, RuntimeError> {
    let item:Option<(i64,bool)>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT octet_length(data),1 FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 UNION ALL SELECT octet_length(data),0 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND ?3 LIMIT 1",params![ct,id,dormant],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?))).optional()?;
    let Some((size,active))=item else { return Ok(None) };
    let scratch=meter.mark();
    meter.heap((size.max(0) as u64).saturating_mul(64).saturating_add(8192))?;
    let sql=if active {"SELECT data FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2"} else {"SELECT data FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2"};
    let text:String=tx.conn().query_row(sql,params![ct,id],|r|r.get(0))?;
    let image:Value=serde_json::from_str(&text).map_err(|e|refuse(e.to_string()))?;
    drop(text);
    meter.release_heap(scratch);
    // Decoder scratch is gone; the decoded image and its write/projection
    // scratch remain resident alongside the walker's page and prior children.
    meter.heap(image.retained_heap_bytes().saturating_mul(4).saturating_add(8192))?;
    Ok(Some(image))
}
fn read_value(tx:&Tx<'_>,t:i64,id:&str,row:&Value,column:&str,meter:&mut Meter)->Result<Option<Value>,RuntimeError>{
    if let Ok(value)=row.field(column) {
        // Includes the retained value, list bookkeeping and scalar-copy scratch.
        meter.heap(value.retained_heap_bytes().saturating_mul(4).saturating_add(8192))?;
        return Ok(Some(value.clone()));
    }
    let bytes:Option<i64>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT octet_length(data) FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",params![t,id,column],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
    let Some(bytes)=bytes else{return Ok(None)};
    let scratch=meter.mark();
    meter.heap((bytes.max(0) as u64).saturating_mul(64).saturating_add(8192))?;
    let text:String=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT data FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",params![t,id,column],|r|r.get(0))?;
    let value:Value=serde_json::from_str(&text).map_err(|e|refuse(e.to_string()))?;
    drop(text);meter.release_heap(scratch);
    meter.heap(value.retained_heap_bytes().saturating_mul(4).saturating_add(8192))?;
    Ok(Some(value))
}
fn validate_receipts(tx:&Tx<'_>,key:&str,pt:i64,id:&str,ct:i64,meter:&mut Meter)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    let mut q=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT octet_length(child_id),child_id FROM _extraction_each_rows WHERE definition=?1 AND parent_t=?2 AND parent_id=?3 ORDER BY child_id")?;
    let mut receipts=q.query(params![key,pt,id])?;
    while let Some(record)=receipts.next()? {
        meter.charge(MeterKind::Examined,1)?;
        let scratch=meter.mark();
        let size:i64=record.get(0)?;
        meter.heap((size.max(0) as u64).saturating_mul(8).saturating_add(128))?;
        let child:String=record.get(1)?;
        if receipt_image(tx,ct,&child,meter)?.is_none() || !anchored(tx,ct,&child,key,pt,id)? {
            return Err(refuse("returning extract each lacks its receipt-owned child or valid parent-lifetime evidence; never recreate pruned/deleted history"));
        }
        drop(child);meter.release_heap(scratch);
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn source<'a>(e:&'a Extraction,child:&Table)->&'a str { mapping(e,child).1 }
pub(super) fn known(tx:&Tx<'_>,key:&str)->Result<bool,RuntimeError>{
    setup(tx)?;
    Ok(tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _extraction_each_definitions WHERE definition=?1)",[key],|r|r.get(0))?)
}
fn validate_all_receipts(tx:&Tx<'_>,key:&str,pt:i64,ct:i64)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    let mut q=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT DISTINCT octet_length(parent_id),parent_id FROM _extraction_each_rows WHERE definition=?1 AND parent_t=?2 AND child_t=?3 ORDER BY parent_id")?;
    let mut parents=q.query(params![key,pt,ct])?;
    while let Some(record)=parents.next()? {
        let mut meter=Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort);
        let size:i64=record.get(0)?;
        meter.heap((size.max(0) as u64).saturating_mul(8).saturating_add(128))?;
        let id:String=record.get(1)?;
        validate_receipts(tx,key,pt,&id,ct,&mut meter)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
// A suspended declaration has already consumed its historical list. Resume
// validates current child custody; it never replays stale list preimages.
pub(super) fn resume(tx:&Tx<'_>,e:&Extraction,parent:&Table,child:&Table,key:&str,report:&mut super::super::adoption_report::AdoptionReport)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    if !known(tx,key)? { return Err(refuse("extract each source list is absent and no successfully applied extraction owns this suspended definition")); }
    let pt=tx.num(&e.parent)?;let ct=tx.num(&e.child)?;
    validate_all_receipts(tx,key,pt,ct)?;
    let (destination,_)=mapping(e,child);let mut count=0u64;
    super::super::activation_walk::walk_metered(tx,ct,crate::rows::adoption::Work::DECODE,None,|id,image,meter|{
        let parent_id=image.field(&e.reference)?.as_str()?;
        if !anchored(tx,ct,id,key,pt,parent_id)? { return Err(refuse("resuming extract each lacks valid captured parent-lifetime evidence; never retrospectively capture an independent child")); }
        let active:bool=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",params![pt,parent_id],|r|r.get(0))?;
        if !active {return Err(refuse("resuming extract each requires its existing current parent; preserve narrowed parent authority in a bridge"));}
        let current=receipt_image(tx,pt,parent_id,meter)?.ok_or_else(||refuse("resuming extract each lost its current parent"))?;
        if let Some(through)=&child.through {
            let current=crate::schema::row_image(&current,parent);
            if through.fields.iter().any(|(capture,field)|image.field(capture).ok()!=current.field(field).ok()) { return Err(refuse("resuming extract each would change captured parent authority; use an authored bridge")); }
        }
        for(dest,src)in &e.fields {
            if dest!=destination && image.field(dest).ok()!=current.field(src).ok() { return Err(refuse("resuming extract each immutable scalar copies disagree with the current parent")); }
        }
        transfer(tx,image.field(destination)?,(&e.child,id,destination),(&e.child,id,destination))?;
        count+=1;Ok(())
    })?;
    report.backfills.push(format!("extract {} each: resumed {count} current child rows without replaying consumed source lists",e.child));
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn forward(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    e: &Extraction,
    parent: &Table,
    child: &Table,
    key: &str,
    report: &mut super::super::adoption_report::AdoptionReport,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    setup(tx)?;
    let pt = tx.num(&e.parent)?;
    let ct = tx.num(&e.child)?;
    let (destination, source) = mapping(e, child);
    validate_all_receipts(tx,key,pt,ct)?;
    let mut count = 0u64;
    super::super::activation_walk::walk_metered(tx, pt, crate::rows::adoption::Work::DECODE, None, |id, mut row, meter| {
        let Some(list) = read_value(tx, pt, id, &row, source, meter)? else {
            return Err(refuse(format!(
                "extract each source {}.{source} is absent",
                e.parent
            )));
        };
        let values = match &list {
            Value::Array(values) => values.as_slice(),
            Value::Null
                if parent
                    .columns
                    .get(source)
                    .is_some_and(ColumnType::is_optional) =>
            {
                &[]
            }
            _ => return Err(refuse("extract each source must be a bounded asset list")),
        };
        let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
        for (position, v) in values.iter().enumerate() {
            meter.charge(MeterKind::RowsWritten, 1)?;
            meter.heap(1024)?; // retained seen-set node/IDs, before cloning them
            let child_scratch=meter.mark();
            let asset_id = asset_id(v)?;
            if !seen.insert(asset_id.clone()) {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "extract each cannot put a repeated asset in two child homes; remove the duplicate element in an authorized source edit",
                ));
            }
            let saved:Option<String>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT child_id FROM _extraction_each_rows WHERE definition=?1 AND parent_t=?2 AND parent_id=?3 AND asset_id=?4",params![key,pt,id,asset_id],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
            let child_id = saved.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
                crate::value::digest(&("extract-each-child", key, pt, id, &asset_id))
            });
            let present = read_image(tx, ct, &child_id, meter, false)?;
            if saved.is_some() {
                if present.is_none() || !anchored(tx, ct, &child_id, key, pt, id)? {
                    return Err(refuse(
                        "returning extract each lacks its receipt-owned child or valid parent-lifetime evidence; never recreate pruned/deleted history",
                    ));
                }
            } else {
                let independent:bool=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _extraction_each_rows WHERE child_t=?1 AND child_id=?2) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _extraction_rows WHERE child_t=?1 AND child_id=?2)",params![ct,child_id],|r|r.get(0))?;
                if present.is_some() || independent {
                    return Err(refuse(format!(
                        "extract each destination {}/{child_id} already has independent history",
                        e.child
                    )));
                }
            }
            let mut image = present.unwrap_or_else(|| {
                Value::Row(
                    BTreeMap::from([
                        ("id".into(), Value::Id(child_id.clone())),
                        (e.reference.clone(), Value::Id(id.into())),
                    ])
                    .into(),
                )
            });
            if image.field(&e.reference) != Ok(&Value::Id(id.into())) {
                return Err(refuse("extract each cannot rebind a child parent"));
            }
            if image.field(destination).is_ok_and(|old| old != v) {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "extract each destination asset conflicts with its source",
                ));
            }
            for (dest, src) in &e.fields {
                if dest == destination {
                    continue;
                }
                let v = read_value(tx, pt, id, &row, src, meter)?.ok_or_else(|| {
                    refuse(format!(
                        "extract each scalar source {}.{src} is absent",
                        e.parent
                    ))
                })?;
                if saved.is_some() && image.field(dest).ok() != Some(&v) {
                    return Err(refuse(
                        "extract each immutable scalar copies disagree with the returning parent",
                    ));
                }
                fields(&mut image)?.insert(dest.clone(), v);
            }
            transfer(
                tx,
                v,
                (&e.parent, id, source),
                (&e.child, &child_id, destination),
            )?;
            fields(&mut image)?.insert(destination.into(), v.clone());
            crate::schema::materialize_optional_fields(&mut image, child);
            write(tx, ct, &child_id, &image)?;
            save(tx, key, pt, id, ct, &child_id, &asset_id, position)?;
            super::super::dormant::capture_refs(
                tx,
                ct,
                &child_id,
                &format!("$extract:{key}"),
                &ColumnType::Ref {
                    table: e.parent.clone(),
                },
                &Value::Id(id.into()),
            )?;
            count += 1;
            drop(image); drop(child_id); drop(saved); drop(asset_id);
            meter.release_heap(child_scratch);
        }
        // Old-client removal has no asset to put back into that receipt's child.
        // Explicit null represents this migration-owned absence so ordinary
        // narrowing retains the other cells without reactivating an empty home.
        let mut q=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT child_id,asset_id FROM _extraction_each_rows WHERE definition=?1 AND parent_t=?2 AND parent_id=?3 ORDER BY child_id")?;
        let mut stale = q.query(params![key, pt, id])?;
        while let Some(record) = stale.next()? {
            meter.charge(MeterKind::Examined, 1)?;
            let child_id: String = record.get(0)?;
            let asset_id: String = record.get(1)?;
            if seen.contains(&asset_id) {
                continue;
            }
            let scratch=meter.mark();
            let mut image = receipt_image(tx, ct, &child_id,meter)?.ok_or_else(|| refuse("extract each lost a receipt-owned child; never recreate pruned/deleted history"))?;
            if image.field(destination).is_ok_and(|v| v != &Value::Null) {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "extract each would discard a child asset absent from the old list; preserve both meanings in a bridge",
                ));
            }
            meter.charge(MeterKind::RowsWritten, 1)?;
            fields(&mut image)?.insert(destination.into(), Value::Null);
            if tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2)",params![ct,child_id],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))? { write(tx, ct, &child_id, &image)?; }
            else { tx.conn().execute("UPDATE _dormant_narrow_rows SET data=?3 WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2",params![ct,child_id,canonical_json(&image)])?; }
            drop(image);
            meter.release_heap(scratch);
        }
        drop(stale);
        drop(q);
        remember(tx, key, pt, id, source, &list, meter)?;
        fields(&mut row)?.remove(source);
        write(tx, pt, id, &row)?;
        Ok(())
    })?;
    tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _extraction_each_definitions VALUES(?1)",[key])?;
    report.backfills.push(format!(
        "extract {} each: prepared {count} child rows and moved existing asset homes",
        e.child
    ));
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn backward(
    tx: &Tx<'_>,
    e: &Extraction,
    parent: &Table,
    current_parent: &Table,
    child: &Table,
    key: &str,
    report: &mut super::super::adoption_report::AdoptionReport,
) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    setup(tx)?;
    let pt = tx.num(&e.parent)?;
    let ct = tx.num(&e.child)?;
    let (destination, source) = mapping(e, child);
    validate_all_receipts(tx,key,pt,ct)?;
    let Some(kind) = parent.columns.get(source) else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    if item_type(kind) != Some(&child.columns[destination]) {
        return Err(refuse(
            "reverse extract each requires identical asset element types in the old bounded list",
        ));
    }
    // Retained populated children are not in the active snapshot. Their homes
    // must never disappear from a reconstructed list. Restore their domain in
    // an explicit loosened child bridge first; migration-owned nulls have no
    // live child asset home and remain safely dormant.
    let hidden:i64=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM _assets a WHERE a.home_table=?1 AND a.home_column=?2 AND a.released_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_narrow_rows n WHERE n.t=?3 AND n.id=a.home_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t=?3 AND r.id=a.home_id)",params![e.child,destination,ct],|r|r.get(0))?;
    if hidden>0 { return Err(refuse(format!("reverse extract each cannot omit {hidden} retained narrowed child asset homes in {}; deploy a loosened child bridge that restores these rows before selecting old source",e.child))); }
    // Index the assembled snapshot once on disk; never rescan all children
    // for each parent or keep the whole store in process memory.
    tx.conn().execute_batch("CREATE TEMP TABLE _extraction_each_children(parent_id TEXT NOT NULL,child_id TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(parent_id,child_id)) WITHOUT ROWID;")?;
    super::super::activation_walk::walk_metered(tx, ct, crate::rows::adoption::Work::DECODE, None, |child_id, image, meter| {
        if let Ok(Value::Id(parent_id)) = image.field(&e.reference) {
            meter.heap(
                (child_id.len() as u64 + parent_id.len() as u64)
                    .saturating_mul(8)
                    .saturating_add(256),
            )?;
            tx.conn().execute(
                "INSERT INTO temp._extraction_each_children VALUES(?1,?2)",
                params![parent_id, child_id],
            )?;
        }
        Ok(())
    })?;
    let mut count = 0u64;
    super::super::activation_walk::walk_metered(tx, pt, crate::rows::adoption::Work::DECODE, None, |id, mut row, meter| {
        let mut children = Vec::new();
        let mut membership=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT octet_length(child_id),child_id FROM temp._extraction_each_children WHERE parent_id=?1 ORDER BY child_id")?;
        let mut members = membership.query([id])?;
        while let Some(member) = members.next()? {
            meter.charge(MeterKind::Examined, 1)?;
            let id_bytes:i64=member.get(0)?;
            meter.heap((id_bytes.max(0) as u64).saturating_mul(8).saturating_add(512))?;
            let child_id: String = member.get(1)?;
            let image = read_image(tx, ct, &child_id, meter, false)?.ok_or_else(|| {
                refuse("extract each child disappeared from its activation snapshot")
            })?;
            let child_id = child_id.as_str();
            if !anchored(tx, ct, child_id, key, pt, id)? {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "extract each child lacks valid parent-lifetime evidence; refusing deletion/id reuse or retrospective recapture",
                ));
            }
            if let Some(through) = &child.through {
                let parent_image = crate::schema::row_image(&row, current_parent);
                if through.fields.iter().any(|(capture, field)| {
                    image.field(capture).ok() != parent_image.field(field).ok()
                }) {
                    return Err(refuse(
                        "reverse extract each would change captured parent authority; preserve the child audience in an authored bridge",
                    ));
                }
            }
            let asset_value=image.field(destination)?;
            meter.heap(asset_value.retained_heap_bytes().saturating_mul(4).saturating_add(512))?;
            let v = asset_value.clone();
            let asset_id = asset_id(&v)?;
            let position:Option<i64>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT position FROM _extraction_each_rows WHERE definition=?1 AND child_t=?2 AND child_id=?3",params![key,ct,child_id],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
            children.push((
                position.unwrap_or(i64::MAX),
                child_id.to_owned(),
                image,
                v,
                asset_id,
            ));
        }
        drop(members);
        drop(membership);
        children.sort_by(|a, b| (&a.0, &a.1).cmp(&(&b.0, &b.1)));
        let mut values = Vec::new();
        let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
        for (position, (_, child_id, mut image, v, asset_id)) in children.into_iter().enumerate() {
            meter.charge(MeterKind::RowsWritten, 1)?;
            if !seen.insert(asset_id.clone()) {
                return Err(refuse(
                    "extract each found competing child homes for one asset",
                ));
            }
            for (dest, src) in &e.fields {
                if dest != destination && row.field(src).ok() != image.field(dest).ok() {
                    return Err(refuse(
                        "extract each immutable scalar copies disagree with the current parent",
                    ));
                }
            }
            transfer(
                tx,
                &v,
                (&e.child, &child_id, destination),
                (&e.parent, id, source),
            )?;
            fields(&mut image)?.remove(destination);
            write(tx, ct, &child_id, &image)?;
            tx.conn().execute(
                "DELETE FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",
                params![ct, child_id, destination],
            )?;
            save(tx, key, pt, id, ct, &child_id, &asset_id, position)?;
            values.push(v);
            count += 1;
        }
        let was_null:bool=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _extraction_cells WHERE definition=?1 AND parent_t=?2 AND parent_id=?3 AND column_name=?4 AND data=?5)",params![key,pt,id,source,canonical_json(&Value::Null)],|r|r.get(0))?;
        let list = if values.is_empty()
            && kind.is_optional()
            && was_null
        {
            Value::Null
        } else {
            Value::Array(values)
        };
        remember(tx, key, pt, id, source, &list, meter)?;
        fields(&mut row)?.insert(source.into(), list);
        write(tx, pt, id, &row)?;
        Ok(())
    })?;
    tx.conn()
        .execute_batch("DROP TABLE temp._extraction_each_children;")?;
    report.backfills.push(format!(
        "extract {} each: moved {count} child asset homes back into parent lists",
        e.child
    ));
    Ok(())
}

//! Typed one-child extraction; home transfer is an activation operation.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#20-visible-rollback-views-roll — an asset is moved with its one home.
use super::*;
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Extraction {
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "std::ops::Not::not")]
    pub each: bool,
    pub child: String,
    pub parent: String,
    pub reference: String,
    pub fields: BTreeMap<String, String>,
}
impl Extraction {
    pub fn admit(&self, schema: &Schema) -> Result<(), String> {
        if schema.extractions.iter().filter(|e|e.child==self.child).count()>1 {
            return Err("one extraction declaration owns each child table; native children cannot be assigned to competing sources".into());
        }
        let child = schema
            .table(&self.child)
            .ok_or("extraction child is not declared")?;
        if self.child == self.parent
            || schema.table(&self.parent).is_none()
            || child.ephemeral.is_some()
            || schema.maintain_for(&self.child).is_some()
        {
            return Err("extraction needs distinct authoritative durable parent and child tables without captured ownership".into());
        }
        if child.columns.get(&self.reference)
            != Some(&ColumnType::Ref {
                table: self.parent.clone(),
            })
        {
            return Err("extraction needs a required reference to its parent".into());
        }
        if !matches!(
            child.on_delete.get(&self.reference),
            Some(references::OnDelete::Cascade | references::OnDelete::Restrict)
        ) {
            return Err("reversible extraction requires on delete cascade or restrict; kept references cannot prove the parent lifetime".into());
        }
        if self.fields.is_empty()
            || self.fields.contains_key(&self.reference)
            || self.fields.keys().any(|c| {
                !child.columns.contains_key(c)
                    || c == "id"
                    || child.engine_field(c)
                    || child.maintained.contains_key(c)
                    || child.sequences.contains_key(c)
                    || child.written_by.contains_key(c)
            })
        {
            return Err("extraction fields must be distinct authoritative child columns".into());
        }
        if self.each {
            let assets:Vec<_>=self.fields.keys().filter(|c|asset(&child.columns[*c])).collect();
            if assets.len()!=1 || !matches!(child.columns[assets[0]],ColumnType::Image{..}|ColumnType::File{..}|ColumnType::Video{..}) {
                return Err("extract each requires exactly one required scalar image/file/video destination; map its historical bounded list".into());
            }
        }
        if !self.fields.keys().any(|c| asset(&child.columns[c])) {
            return Err("extraction needs at least one mapped image/file column".into());
        }
        if child.columns.iter().any(|(c, k)| {
            c != &self.reference
                && c != "id"
                && !self.fields.contains_key(c)
                && !k.is_optional()
                && !child.defaults.contains_key(c)
                && !child.engine_field(c)
        }) {
            return Err("map every required child column or give it an explicit default".into());
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}
pub(super) fn asset(k: &ColumnType) -> bool {
    match k {
        ColumnType::Optional(k)
        | ColumnType::List { of: k, .. }
        | ColumnType::ListRange { of: k, .. } => asset(k),
        ColumnType::Image { .. } | ColumnType::File { .. } | ColumnType::Video { .. } => true,
        _ => false,
    }
}

fn restore_downfills(tx:&Tx<'_>,next:&Schema,previous:Option<&Schema>,sources:&BTreeMap<String,Table>,report:&mut super::adoption_report::AdoptionReport)->Result<(),RuntimeError>{
    for validate in [true,false] {
    for fill in &next.downfills {
        let t=tx.num(&fill.table)?;let key=fill.down_key();let table=&next.tables[&fill.table];
        let mut bad=super::adopt_refusals::Samples::default();let mut count=0;
        walk_images(tx,t,|id,mut row,in_r|{
            let Some(mut e)=evidence(tx,t,id,&key)? else {
                let pruned:Option<bool>=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT active FROM _backfill_pruned WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND definition=?3",params![t,id,key],|r|r.get(0)).optional()?;
                if let Some(active)=pruned {
                    let carried=previous.is_some_and(|old|old.downfills.iter().any(|f|f.down_key()==key));
                    let mut available=active;
                    if active {for c in fill.outputs.iter().filter(|c|table.columns.contains_key(*c)) {
                        let selected=carried&&previous.and_then(|old|old.table(&fill.table)).is_some_and(|old|old.columns.contains_key(c));
                        if !selected&&row.field(c).is_err()&&!tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3)",params![t,id,c],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))? {available=false;}
                    }}
                    if !available {bad.add(id,"reverse projection evidence was explicitly pruned; restore a backup or keep a bridge release");}
                }
                return Ok(())
            };
            if e.active{return Ok(())}
            assemble_owned_cells(tx,t,id,&mut row,e.after.keys().map(String::as_str))?;
            let fields=row.as_object()?;
            if validate {
            for (column,expected) in &e.after {
                if fields.get(column)!=Some(expected) {bad.add(id,&format!("{}.{} changed while the older release was active; expected projected {}, current {}; repair it under a bridge before selecting this release",fill.table,column,canonical_json(expected),fields.get(column).map(canonical_json).unwrap_or_else(||"<absent>".into())));return Ok(())}
            }
            let mut inputs_meter=Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort);
            let source=row_source(tx,t,id,sources.get(&fill.table))?;
            for (column,original) in &e.inputs.as_object()?.iter().map(|(k,v)|(k.clone(),v.clone())).collect::<BTreeMap<_,_>>() {
                if input_lifetime_lost(tx,t,id,&key,column)? {bad.add(id,&format!("reverse input {column} lost its parent lifetime; restore a backup or use a typed bridge"));return Ok(())}
                    let current=source_value(tx,t,id,&row,column,source.as_deref().or(Some(table)),&mut inputs_meter)?.unwrap_or(Value::Null);
                    if &current!=original
                        && !receipt_preimage(tx,next,&fill.table,t,id,column,fields.get(column),original,source.as_deref())? {
                        bad.add(id,&format!("{}.{} changed while the older release was active; original input {}, current {}; reverse dependencies cannot be recaptured",fill.table,column,canonical_json(original),canonical_json(&current)));return Ok(())
                    }
            }
            return Ok(())
            }
            let fields=match &mut row {Value::Row(f)|Value::Map(f)=>f,_=>return Err(refusal("invalid stored row"))};
            for column in e.reversed.keys() {
                match e.reversed.get(column).cloned().flatten() {
                    Some(value)=>{
                        fields.insert(column.clone(),value.clone());
                    },
                    None=>{
                        fields.remove(column);
                        note_native_absence(tx,t,id,column)?;
                        tx.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _dormant_refs WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3",params![t,id,column])?;
                        // A rename/down round trip must not feed the archived
                        // old-view result back into a forward declaration whose
                        // original input was physically absent.
                        tx.conn().execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO temp._backfill_unprovided VALUES(?1,?2,?3)",params![t,id,column])?;
                    }
                }
            }
            // Restore the receipt's native image before ordinary destination
            // narrowing, including a native row that was already out of domain.
            patch_retained(tx,t,id,e.reversed.iter().map(|(c,v)|(c.as_str(),v.as_ref())))?;
            e.active=true;if in_r {tx.conn().execute("UPDATE r SET data=?1 WHERE t=?2 AND id=?3",params![canonical_json(&row),t,id])?;}save(tx,t,id,&key,&e,true)?;count+=1;Ok(())
        })?;
        if bad.count>0{return Err(refusal(format!("down {} {} forward: {}",fill.table,fill.name,bad.describe())))}
        if count>0 {report.backfills.push(format!("{} {} restored {count} native {}",fill.table,fill.name,if count==1{"row"}else{"rows"}));tx.set_meta("activation_population","true")?;}
    }} Ok(())
}

fn stage_downfills(tx:&Tx<'_>,next:&Schema,previous:&Schema,sources:&BTreeMap<String,Table>,now:i64,report:&mut super::adoption_report::AdoptionReport)->Result<bool,RuntimeError>{
    let next_keys:BTreeSet<String>=next.downfills.iter().map(Backfill::down_key).collect();
    let leaving:Vec<_>=previous.downfills.iter().filter(|f|!next_keys.contains(&f.down_key())&&next.table(&f.table).is_some_and(|t|f.outputs.iter().any(|c|t.columns.contains_key(c)))).collect();
    if leaving.is_empty(){return Ok(false)}
    let mut source=previous.clone();source.backfills.clear();source.downfills.clear();
    let mut rebuilt_reads=BTreeSet::new();
    tx.conn().execute_batch("CREATE TEMP TABLE _downfill_pending(t INTEGER NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,definition TEXT NOT NULL,patch TEXT NOT NULL,evidence TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(t,id,definition)) WITHOUT ROWID;")?;
    for fill in leaving {
        fill.admit_down(previous).map_err(refusal)?;
        let Some(target)=next.table(&fill.table) else {continue};
        let target_outputs:BTreeSet<_>=fill.outputs.iter().filter(|c|target.columns.contains_key(*c)).cloned().collect();
        if target_outputs.is_empty(){continue}
        if fill.name.starts_with("$rename:down:") {
                if fill.inputs.len()!=1 || fill.outputs.len()!=1 {return Err(refusal("generated column rename must have exactly one input and output"))}

            let source_kind=fill.inputs.values().next();let target_kind=target_outputs.iter().next().and_then(|c|target.columns.get(c));
            if source_kind!=target_kind {return Err(refusal(format!("column rename on {} must use identical old and new cell types",fill.table)))}
        }
        for c in &target_outputs {
            let kind=&target.columns[c];
            if protected(kind) || target.engine_field(c) || target.sequences.contains_key(c) || target.maintained.contains_key(c) || target.expire.as_ref()==Some(c) || target.not_before.as_ref()==Some(c) {
                return Err(refusal(format!("down {} {} output {c} must be an authoritative scalar without reference or lifetime ownership",fill.table,fill.name)))
            }
        }
        let t=tx.num(&fill.table)?;let key=fill.down_key();let mut bad=super::adopt_refusals::Samples::default();let mut count=0;let mut preimages=0u64;let mut preimage_ids=Vec::new();
        walk_images(tx,t,|id,row,_in_r|{
            let prior=evidence(tx,t,id,&key)?;
            let eligible=!absence(tx,t,id,&format!("$native:{key}"))?.is_empty();
            if prior.is_none() && !eligible{return Ok(())}
            if let Some(prior)=&prior {if !prior.active {
                let fields=row.as_object()?;
                if prior.after.iter().any(|(c,v)|target_outputs.contains(c)&&fields.get(c)!=Some(v)) {
                    bad.add(id,"projected cells changed before their native receipt was restored; repair under a bridge");
                }
                return Ok(())
            }}
            let fields=row.as_object()?;
            // Only a forward receipt that actually owns this output supplies
            // a predecessor preimage. Unrelated transformation history on the
            // same lifetime must not suppress a disjoint reverse projection.
            let mut forward_outputs=BTreeSet::new();
            let mut q=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT octet_length(d.definition),d.definition FROM _backfill_evidence e JOIN _backfill_definitions d ON d.digest=e.definition WHERE e.t=?1 AND e.id=?2 ORDER BY e.definition")?;
            let mut receipts=q.query(params![t,id])?;
            while let Some(r)=receipts.next()? {
                let mut admission=Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort);admission.heap((r.get::<_,i64>(0)?.max(0) as u64).saturating_mul(64).saturating_add(8192))?;
                let definition:Backfill=decode(&r.get::<_,String>(1)?)?;
                if let Some(receipt)=evidence(tx,t,id,&definition.key())? {
                    // A declared down owns the view of an edited in-place output.
                    // Unedited outputs still restore their exact predecessor.
                    forward_outputs.extend(definition.outputs.into_iter().filter(|c|
                        !receipt.authored.contains(c) && (fields.get(c)==receipt.after.get(c) || fields.get(c)==receipt.before.get(c))));
                }
            }
            drop(receipts);drop(q);
            // An entering inactive receipt restores exact native cells. Those
            // preimages outrank a different leaving declaration's substitution.
            for entering in next.downfills.iter().filter(|f|f.table==fill.table) {
                if let Some(e)=evidence(tx,t,id,&entering.down_key())? {if !e.active {forward_outputs.extend(e.reversed.into_keys());}}
            }
            let mut pruned_outputs=BTreeSet::new();
            let mut q=tx.conn().prepare("SELECT octet_length(d.definition),d.definition FROM _backfill_pruned p JOIN _backfill_definitions d ON d.digest=p.definition WHERE p.t=?1 AND p.id=?2 ORDER BY p.definition")?;
            let mut receipts=q.query(params![t,id])?;
            while let Some(r)=receipts.next()? {
                let mut admission=Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort);admission.heap((r.get::<_,i64>(0)?.max(0) as u64).saturating_mul(64).saturating_add(8192))?;
                pruned_outputs.extend(decode::<Backfill>(&r.get::<_,String>(1)?)?.outputs);
            }
            drop(receipts);drop(q);
            if target_outputs.iter().any(|c|pruned_outputs.contains(c)) {bad.add(id,"forward predecessor preimage was explicitly pruned");return Ok(())}
            let mut projected_outputs=BTreeSet::new();
            for c in &target_outputs {
                if forward_outputs.contains(c){continue}
                // An active receipt means this cell was supplied by this down
                // declaration on the preceding rollback.  Its archived copy
                // is therefore a prior down result, not a predecessor
                // preimage, and the next cycle must issue a fresh receipt so
                // edits under the older release remain conflict checked.
                if prior.as_ref().is_some_and(|e|e.active && e.reversed.contains_key(c)) {
                    projected_outputs.insert(c.clone());
                    continue;
                }
                // A non-null retained predecessor value is an exact preimage.
                // Legacy rollback loops could manufacture optional null cells;
                // the explicit down declaration is the author's substitution
                // policy for that otherwise ambiguous evidence-free case.
                let retained=tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _dormant_values WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND column_name=?3 AND data!=?4)",params![t,id,c,canonical_json(&Value::Null)],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))?;
                // @ref LLP 3000.000.000.002#10-wave-25-day-two-friction-dx8 — an identical-type rename presents the current business value in the old spelling.
                if !retained || fill.name.starts_with("$rename:down:") {projected_outputs.insert(c.clone());}
            }
            if projected_outputs.len()<target_outputs.len(){preimages+=1;if preimage_ids.len()<5{preimage_ids.push(id.to_owned());}}
            if projected_outputs.is_empty(){return Ok(())}
            if prior.is_none() && tx.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _backfill_pruned WHERE t=?1 AND id=?2 AND definition=?3)",params![t,id,key],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))? {
                bad.add(id,"reverse projection evidence was explicitly pruned");return Ok(())
            }
            let native_source=row_source(tx,t,id,sources.get(&fill.table))?;
            if let Some(source)=native_source.as_deref() {if let Some(c)=projected_outputs.iter().find(|c|source.columns.get(*c).is_some_and(protected)||source_owned(source,c)) {
                bad.add(id,&format!("native preimage {}.{c} requires reference, asset or lifetime custody; keep a typed bridge",fill.table));return Ok(())
            }}
            let mut args=BTreeMap::new();
            for (c,kind) in &fill.inputs {
                let value=source_value(tx,t,id,&row,c,native_source.as_deref().or(Some(&previous.tables[&fill.table])),&mut Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort))?;
                if crate::engine::validate::validate_column(&fill.table,c,kind,value.as_ref()).is_err(){bad.add(id,&format!("current reverse input {}.{c} is absent or invalid",fill.table));return Ok(())}
                args.insert(c.clone(),value.unwrap_or(Value::Null));
            }
            let inputs=Value::Row(args.clone().into());let mut context=migration_context(tx,now)?;context.args=args;
            for (c,kind) in &fill.inputs {
                let kind=native_source.as_deref().and_then(|s|s.columns.get(c)).filter(|k|protected(k)).unwrap_or(kind);
                let value=inputs.field(c)?;let unchanged=prior.as_ref().is_none_or(|e|e.inputs.field(c).ok()==Some(value));
                capture_input_refs(tx,t,id,c,&input_ref(&key,c),kind,value,unchanged)?;
                if input_lifetime_lost(tx,t,id,&key,c)? {bad.add(id,&format!("reverse input {c} lost its parent lifetime; use a typed bridge"));return Ok(())}
            }
            let mut reads=BTreeSet::new();collect_reads(&fill.program.body,&mut reads);
            let needed=reads.difference(&rebuilt_reads).cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
            if !needed.is_empty(){rebuild_reads(tx,&source,&needed)?;tx.clear_activation_scan();tx.set_meta("activation_population","true")?;rebuilt_reads.extend(needed);}
            let mut runner=Runner::new(tx,&source,context,Meter::new(Ceilings::job(),Cut::Abort),0);
            let patch=match runner.run(&fill.program){Ok(Value::Row(f)|Value::Map(f))=>f.into_iter().collect::<BTreeMap<_,_>>(),Ok(_)=>{bad.add(id,"down projection did not return an object");return Ok(())},Err(e)=>{bad.add(id,&e.to_string());return Ok(())}};
            if runner.read_cut().is_some(){bad.add(id,"reverse lookup did not complete; reduce its bounded work");return Ok(())}
            if patch.keys().cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>()!=fill.outputs{return Err(refusal("down projection returned undeclared output fields"))}
            let patch:BTreeMap<_,_>=patch.into_iter().filter(|(c,_)|projected_outputs.contains(c)).collect();
            let reversed=projected_outputs.iter().map(|c|{
                // Each rollback owns this cycle's current physical preimage,
                // including newer writes and absence since the last restoration.
                let value=fields.get(c).cloned();
                (c.clone(),value)
            }).collect();
            let e=Evidence{computed:BTreeMap::new(),authored:BTreeSet::new(),reversed,retained:BTreeSet::new(),absent:BTreeSet::new(),epoch:tx.meta("generation")?.and_then(|s|s.parse::<i64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0).saturating_add(1),active:false,inputs,before:BTreeMap::new(),after:patch.clone()};
            tx.conn().execute("INSERT INTO temp._downfill_pending VALUES(?1,?2,?3,?4,?5)",params![t,id,key,canonical_json(&patch),canonical_json(&e)])?;count+=1;Ok(())
        })?;
        if bad.count>0{return Err(refusal(format!("down {} {}: {}",fill.table,fill.name,bad.describe())))}
        if preimages>0 {report.backfills.push(format!("{} {} retained predecessor preimages on {preimages} rows; sample ids [{}]; these rows read stale under the older release until forward; newer source cells remain retained for forward",fill.table,fill.name,preimage_ids.join(", ")));}
        if count>0{report.backfills.push(format!("{} {} projected {count} {} down",fill.table,fill.name,if count==1{"row"}else{"rows"}));}
    }
    Ok(true)
}

#[cfg(unix)]
pub(crate) fn identity(store: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
    let path = store.canonicalize().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let m = snapback4_core::private_fs::database_metadata(&path)
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .ok_or("store disappeared")?;
    Ok(crate::native::digest(
        &serde_json::to_vec(&(path.as_os_str().as_bytes(), m.dev(), m.ino())).unwrap(),
    ))
}

#[cfg(unix)]
fn peer(stream: &UnixStream) -> io::Result<()> {
    use std::os::fd::AsRawFd;
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    let uid = {
        let mut credentials = std::mem::MaybeUninit::<libc::ucred>::uninit();
        let mut size = std::mem::size_of::<libc::ucred>() as libc::socklen_t;
        if unsafe {
            libc::getsockopt(
                stream.as_raw_fd(),
                libc::SOL_SOCKET,
                libc::SO_PEERCRED,
                credentials.as_mut_ptr().cast(),
                &mut size,
            )
        } != 0
        {
            return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
        }
        if size as usize != std::mem::size_of::<libc::ucred>() {
            return Err(io::Error::other("invalid peer credentials"));
        }
        unsafe { credentials.assume_init() }.uid
    };
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    let uid = {
        let (mut uid, mut gid) = (0, 0);
        if unsafe { libc::getpeereid(stream.as_raw_fd(), &mut uid, &mut gid) } != 0 {
            return Err(io::Error::last_os_error());
        }
        uid
    };
    #[cfg(not(any(target_os = "linux", target_os = "macos")))]
    return Err(io::Error::other(
        "release control peer credentials unsupported on this Unix host",
    ));
    #[cfg(any(target_os = "linux", target_os = "macos"))]
    if uid != unsafe { libc::geteuid() } {
        return Err(io::Error::other(
            "release control requires the same filesystem owner",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(unix)]
fn socket_entry(path: &Path) -> io::Result<fs::Metadata> {
    let m = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
    if !m.file_type().is_socket()
        || m.uid() != unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
        || m.permissions().mode() & 0o7777 != 0o600
    {
        return Err(io::Error::other(
            "release control must be a same-owner 0600 socket, never a symlink or regular file",
        ));
    }
    Ok(m)
}

// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#51-path-independent-control-address — fixed short runtime root, independent of shell environment.
#[cfg(unix)]
fn private_directory(path: &Path, create: bool) -> io::Result<()> {
    if create {
        match fs::DirBuilder::new().mode(0o700).create(path) {
            Ok(()) => {}
            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => {}
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        }
    }
    // Do not chmod or follow an existing entry. A stranger can pre-create a
    // name in /tmp, but cannot turn that into a capability or chmod target.
    let directory = fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .read(true)
        .custom_flags(libc::O_DIRECTORY | libc::O_NOFOLLOW)
        .open(path)?;
    directory_metadata(&directory.metadata()?, unsafe { libc::geteuid() })
}

#[cfg(unix)]
fn directory_metadata(m: &fs::Metadata, uid: u32) -> io::Result<()> {
    if !m.is_dir() || m.uid() != uid || m.permissions().mode() & 0o7777 != 0o700 {
        return Err(io::Error::other(
            "release control runtime directory must be a same-owner 0700 directory",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(unix)]
fn address(dir: &Path, create: bool) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {
    let directory = PathBuf::from(format!("/tmp/snapback4-{}", unsafe { libc::geteuid() }));
    private_directory(&directory, create)?;
    let canonical = dir.canonicalize()?;
    // Bind the address to immutable deployment source, even when two
    // deployments symlink their database to the same store. The actual
    // database path/inode is separately checked in every envelope.
    Ok(directory.join(format!(
        "{}.sock",
        crate::native::digest(canonical.as_os_str().as_bytes())
    )))
}

// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#51-path-independent-control-address — a total input deadline bounds shutdown even when a peer keeps sending bytes.
#[cfg(unix)]
fn input(stream: &mut UnixStream, timeout: Duration) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let deadline = Instant::now() + timeout;
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    let mut buffer = [0; INPUT + 1];
    while bytes.len() <= INPUT {
        let remaining = deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());
        if remaining.is_zero() {
            return Err(io::Error::new(
                io::ErrorKind::TimedOut,
                "release control input deadline exceeded",
            ));
        }
        stream.set_read_timeout(Some(remaining))?;
        match stream.read(&mut buffer[..INPUT + 1 - bytes.len()]) {
            Ok(0) => break,
            Ok(n) => bytes.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..n]),
            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => continue,
            Err(e) => return Err(e),
        }
    }
    Ok(bytes)
}

/// Only called while the exclusive database sidecar is held, so stale socket
/// replacement cannot disconnect another admitted serving owner.
#[cfg(unix)]
pub(crate) struct Listener {
    listener: UnixListener,
    path: PathBuf,
    inode: (u64, u64),
    identity: String,
}
#[cfg(unix)]
impl Listener {
    pub(crate) fn bind(dir: &Path, store: &Path) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let identity = identity(store)?;
        let path = address(dir, true).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        match fs::symlink_metadata(&path) {
            Ok(_) => {
                socket_entry(&path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                match UnixStream::connect(&path) {
                    Ok(_) => {
                        return Err("release control socket already has a live listener".into());
                    }
                    Err(e)
                        if matches!(
                            e.kind(),
                            io::ErrorKind::ConnectionRefused | io::ErrorKind::NotFound
                        ) => {}
                    Err(e) => return Err(e.to_string()),
                }
                fs::remove_file(&path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            }
            Err(e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
            Err(e) => return Err(e.to_string()),
        }
        let listener = UnixListener::bind(&path)
            .map_err(|e| format!("release control {}: {e}", path.display()))?;
