//! Table names may change; numeric row, reference and receipt lifetimes do not.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000.002#8-wave-21-release-evolution — renames are identity moves, never row copies or merges.
use super::*;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
pub(super) const VERSION:&str="snapback4-release-store-10";
fn refuse(s:impl Into<String>)->RuntimeError {RuntimeError::Structural{code:"E_ADOPT",message:s.into()}}

// Only structural table identifiers change. Literal values, column names,
// operation names and authored defaults are never table identifiers.
fn identifiers(value:&mut serde_json::Value,map:&BTreeMap<String,String>) {
    match value {
        serde_json::Value::Array(xs)=>for x in xs {identifiers(x,map)},
        serde_json::Value::Object(fields)=>for (key,x) in fields {
            if key=="Literal" || key=="defaults" {continue;}
            if matches!(key.as_str(),"table"|"parent") {if let Some(name)=x.as_str().and_then(|s|map.get(s)){*x=serde_json::Value::String(name.clone());continue;}}
            identifiers(x,map);
        },_=>()
    }
}
fn mapped(name:&str,map:&BTreeMap<String,String>)->String {map.get(name).cloned().unwrap_or_else(||name.into())}
fn remap<T:serde::Serialize+serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(value:&T,map:&BTreeMap<String,String>)->Result<T,RuntimeError> {
    let mut json=serde_json::to_value(value).map_err(|e|RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?;identifiers(&mut json,map);
    serde_json::from_value(json).map_err(|e|RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))
}
pub(crate) fn schema(mut schema:Schema,map:&BTreeMap<String,String>)->Result<Schema,RuntimeError> {
    if map.is_empty(){return Ok(schema)}
    schema.tables=std::mem::take(&mut schema.tables).into_iter().map(|(name,table)|Ok((mapped(&name,map),remap(&table,map)?))).collect::<Result<_,RuntimeError>>()?;
    for m in &mut schema.maintains {*m=remap(m,map)?;m.source=mapped(&m.source,map);m.target=mapped(&m.target,map);}
    for f in &mut schema.backfills {fill(f,map,false)?;}
    for f in &mut schema.downfills {fill(f,map,true)?;}
    for e in &mut schema.extractions {e.child=mapped(&e.child,map);}
    // Remaining table-bearing structural metadata is normalized through the
    // same typed codec; maintains' source/target are handled explicitly above.
    // These maps contain column identifiers, including arbitrary keys such as
    // "parent". Normalize their typed table slots, never their column strings.
    let mut extractions=std::mem::take(&mut schema.extractions);
    for e in &mut extractions {e.parent=mapped(&e.parent,map);}
    let columns=std::mem::take(&mut schema.asset_renames).into_iter().map(|(name,columns)|(mapped(&name,map),columns)).collect();
    schema.table_renames.clear();schema=remap(&schema,map)?;
    schema.extractions=extractions;schema.asset_renames=columns;
    Ok(schema)
}
fn fill(f:&mut crate::schema::backfill::Backfill,map:&BTreeMap<String,String>,down:bool)->Result<(),RuntimeError> {
    *f=remap(f,map)?;
    f.program.name=format!("{}{}{}",if down{"down"}else{"backfill"},f.table,f.name);Ok(())
}
pub(super) fn prepare(conn:&Connection,next:&Schema,catalog:&mut BTreeMap<String,i64>)->Result<BTreeMap<String,String>,RuntimeError> {
    let exists:bool=conn.query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name='_table_renames')",[],|r|r.get(0))?;
    if !exists && next.table_renames.is_empty(){return Ok(BTreeMap::new())}
    conn.execute_batch("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _table_renames(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,origin TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID;")?;
    let mut names:BTreeMap<String,String>=conn.prepare("SELECT name,origin FROM _table_renames")?.query_map([],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?)))?.collect::<Result<_,_>>()?;
    for (new,old) in &next.table_renames {
        if new==old || !next.tables.contains_key(new) || next.tables.contains_key(old){return Err(refuse("table rename requires a distinct predecessor-only source"))}
        let origin=names.get(old).cloned().unwrap_or_else(||old.clone());
        if names.get(new).is_some_and(|root|root!=&origin){return Err(refuse(format!("table rename {old} → {new} conflicts with an independent retained identity")))}
        if let (Some(a),Some(b))=(catalog.get(old),catalog.get(new)) {if a!=b{return Err(refuse(format!("table rename {old} → {new} cannot merge existing table lifetimes")))}}
        for name in [old,new] {names.insert(name.clone(),origin.clone());conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _table_renames VALUES(?1,?2)",params![name,origin])?;}
    }
    let mut selected=BTreeMap::<String,String>::new();
    for name in next.tables.keys() {if let Some(root)=names.get(name) {if let Some(other)=selected.insert(root.clone(),name.clone()){return Err(refuse(format!("table aliases {other} and {name} cannot be active together")))}}}
    let map:BTreeMap<String,String>=names.iter().filter_map(|(name,root)|selected.get(root).filter(|new|*new!=name).map(|new|(name.clone(),new.clone()))).collect();
    for (old,new) in &map {
        if !catalog.contains_key(old){continue;}
        if catalog.contains_key(new){return Err(refuse(format!("table rename {old} → {new} conflicts with retained table storage")))}
        let entries:Vec<_>=catalog.iter().filter(|(key,_)|*key==old || key.starts_with(&format!("{old}."))).map(|(k,v)|(k.clone(),*v)).collect();
        for (key,num) in entries {let renamed=format!("{new}{}",&key[old.len()..]);conn.execute("UPDATE _catalog SET name=?1 WHERE name=?2",params![renamed,key])?;catalog.remove(&key);catalog.insert(renamed,num);}
        conn.execute("UPDATE _assets SET home_table=?1 WHERE home_table=?2",params![new,old])?;
        for table in ["_dormant_tables","_dormant_columns","_dormant_indexes"] {
            if conn.query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name=?1)",[table],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))? {conn.execute(&format!("UPDATE {table} SET table_name=?1 WHERE table_name=?2"),params![new,old])?;}
        }
    }
    // Retained typed definitions must use the current public table names too.
    for table in ["_dormant_tables","_dormant_columns","_dormant_narrow_rows"] {
        if !conn.query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name=?1)",[table],|r|r.get::<_,bool>(0))? {continue;}
        let rows:Vec<(String,String)>=conn.prepare(&format!("SELECT definition,definition FROM {table} GROUP BY definition"))?.query_map([],|r|Ok((r.get(0)?,r.get(1)?)))?.collect::<Result<_,_>>()?;
        for (old,text) in rows {let mut json:serde_json::Value=serde_json::from_str(&text).map_err(|e|RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?;identifiers(&mut json,&map);let new=canonical_json(&json);if old!=new {conn.execute(&format!("UPDATE {table} SET definition=?1 WHERE definition=?2"),params![new,old])?;}}
    }
    history(conn,&map)?;
    conn.execute("UPDATE _meta SET value=?1 WHERE key='version'",[VERSION])?;
    Ok(map)
}

//! Server construction facts belong to the transaction that accepts the open.
// @ref LLP 3000.033#1.3 — no fallible construction reads after commit.
use super::*;

pub(crate) use crate::store_port::OpeningMetadata as Metadata;

impl Metadata {
    pub fn read(tx: &impl crate::metadata::MetadataReader) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        Ok(Self {
            store_id: tx.store_identity()?.unwrap_or_default(),
            dev_effects: tx.release_value()?.is_none(),
        })
    }
}

/// An open that needs activation releases its first snapshot. Bind that repair
/// to the exact stored backend it validated, not just the declared hash.
pub(crate) use crate::activation::Backend;

impl Backend {
    pub fn check(&self, conn: &Connection) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        let raw: Option<String> = conn.query_row("SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key='generation'", [], |row| row.get(0)).optional()?;
        let generation = crate::activation::stored_generation(raw.as_deref())?;
        let held: (i64, String, String) = conn.query_row(
            "SELECT generation, schema, programs FROM _generations WHERE generation = ?1",
            [generation], |row| Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?, row.get(2)?)))?;
        crate::activation::check_backend(&Backend(held.0, held.1, held.2), self)
    }
}

impl Store {
    pub(super) fn check_version(conn: &Connection) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        let version: String = conn.query_row("SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key = 'version'", [], |r| r.get(0))?;
        Self::validate_version(&version)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    // @ref LLP 3000.000.000.001#11-wave-22-loop-repairs-dx6 — later known-family formats require an explicit upgrade repair.
    pub(super) fn validate_version(version: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        if [STORE_VERSION, super::dormant::VERSION, "snapback4-release-store-2", "snapback4-release-store-6", "snapback4-release-store-8", "snapback4-release-store-9", super::table_renames::VERSION, super::backfills::VERSION].contains(&version) {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let newer = version.strip_prefix("snapback4-release-store-").and_then(|number| number.parse::<u64>().ok()).is_some_and(|number| number > 10)
            || version.strip_prefix("snapback4-store-").and_then(|number| number.parse::<u64>().ok()).is_some_and(|number| number > 1);
        let owner = if newer { format!("a newer Snapback ({version}); upgrade Snapback before opening this data directory") }
            else { format!("another Snapback ({version}); expected a supported {STORE_VERSION} format") };
        Err(RuntimeError::Store(format!("this data directory belongs to {owner}")))
    }

    pub(crate) fn opening_transaction(&mut self) -> Result<Tx<'_>, RuntimeError> {
        let tx = if self.conn.is_readonly("main")? { self.read_transaction()? } else { self.transaction()? };
        Self::check_version(tx.conn())?;
        let catalog = tx.conn().prepare("SELECT name, num FROM _catalog")?.query_map([], |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?)))?.collect::<Result<BTreeMap<String, i64>, _>>()?;
        if &catalog != tx.catalog {
            return Err(RuntimeError::Generation("the catalog changed while opening; retry open".into()));
        }
        Ok(tx)
    }

    /// The caller keeps its validation transaction until all construction reads
    /// and upgrades finish. Read-only inspection never installs anything.
    pub(crate) fn finish_open(tx: Tx<'_>) -> Result<Metadata, RuntimeError> {
        if tx.conn().is_readonly("main")? {
            let metadata = Metadata::read(&tx)?;
            tx.rollback()?;
            return Ok(metadata);
        }
        Self::initialize_schema(tx.conn())?;
        Self::initialize_change_evidence(tx.conn())?;
        let metadata = Metadata::read(&tx)?;
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(metadata)
    }
}

impl Engine {
    pub(super) fn activate(
        store: &mut AnyStore,
        schema: &Schema,
        programs: &BTreeMap<String, Program>,
        release: Option<&release::ReleaseActivation>,
        now: i64,
        allow_feed_adoption: bool,
        expected_release: Option<u64>,
        expected_backend: Option<&crate::activation::Backend>,
    ) -> Result<Committed<(u64, crate::store_port::OpeningMetadata)>, RuntimeError> {
        store.admit(schema, programs)?;
        if let Some(release) = release { release.validate()?; }
        schema.validate_column_owners()?;
        for program in programs.values() {
            crate::schema::ephemeral::admit_program(schema, program)?;
            admission::check_state_predicates(schema, program)?;
        }
        for program in programs.values() {
            for table in crate::ir::read_sites(program)
                .into_iter()
                .map(|s| s.table)
                .chain(crate::ir::write_tables(program).into_iter().map(|(t, _)| t))
            {
                schema.refuse_private(&table)?;
            }
        }
        for schedule in &schema.schedules {
            if !schedule.valid()
            {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(format!(
                    "schedule {} has an invalid period or offset",
                    schedule.name
                )));
            }
            let Some(program) = programs
                .get(&schedule.target)
                .filter(|p| matches!(p.kind, ProgramKind::Job | ProgramKind::Action))
            else {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(format!(
                    "schedule {} names missing job or action {}; restore or remove the schedule",
                    schedule.name, schedule.target
                )));
            };
            if program.kind == ProgramKind::Action {
                let seat = schedule
                    .service
                    .as_deref()
                    .filter(|seat| crate::identity::is_service(seat))
                    .ok_or_else(|| {
                        RuntimeError::Schema(
                            "a scheduled action requires its declared service seat".into(),
                        )
                    })?;
                actions::authorize(program, seat)?;
            } else if schedule.service.is_some() {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(
                    "a scheduled job cannot name a service seat".into(),
                ));
            }
            if program.args.iter().any(|(name, kind)| {
                !matches!(name.as_str(), "periodStart" | "periodEnd")
                    || *kind != crate::ir::ArgType::Time
            }) {
                return Err(RuntimeError::Schema(
                    "scheduled work takes periodStart: time and periodEnd: time, or nothing".into(),
                ));
            }
        }
        let prior_items = std::cell::RefCell::new(Vec::new());
        let population=std::cell::Cell::new(None);
        Committer::run_committed_with(store, |store| {
        let outcome=store.activate_at_with_launch(schema, Some(programs), false, now, allow_feed_adoption, |release_check| {
            release_check.check_selected_release(expected_release)?;
            if let Some(backend) = expected_backend { release_check.check_backend(backend)?; }
            if let Some(options)=release {
                options.check(release_check)?;
                *prior_items.borrow_mut()=release_check.activation_inventory()?;
                release_check.enable_dormant()?;
                release_check.prepare_release_metadata(options.native_digest.as_deref().unwrap_or(""), options.restore_dormant,options.visibility.as_ref())?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }, |tx, changed, report| {
            let now=now.max(ActivationReader::time_audience_clock(tx)?);
            if let Some(options)=release {tx.set_active_release(options.release)?;}
            let repair_live_sums = tx.live_sum_marker()?.as_deref() != Some("1");
            let previous: Option<String> = tx.previous_schema()?;
            let previous: Option<Schema> = previous.map(|text| serde_json::from_str(&text).map_err(|e| RuntimeError::decode(e, RuntimeError::Store))).transpose()?;
            if let Some(previous) = &previous {
                let backend = tx.opening_backend()?;
                let previous_programs = serde_json::from_str(&backend.2).map_err(|e| RuntimeError::decode(e, RuntimeError::Store))?;
                super::activation_facts::check_operations(previous, schema, &previous_programs, programs)?;
            }
            let needs_maintained_id_marker = (schema.maintains.iter().any(|maintain| maintain.row_key.is_none())
                || previous.as_ref().is_some_and(|old| old.maintains.iter().any(|maintain| maintain.row_key.is_none())))
                && tx.schema_marker(crate::metadata::SchemaMarker::MaintainedIds)?.as_deref() != Some(crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_VERSION);
            if !changed && !repair_live_sums && !needs_maintained_id_marker { return Ok(()); }
            let repair_maintained_ids = needs_maintained_id_marker
                && previous.as_ref().is_some_and(|old| old.maintains.iter().any(|maintain| maintain.row_key.is_none()));
            if changed {
                let epoch = tx.next_seq()?;
                for table in partition::changed_group_audiences(previous.as_ref(), schema) {
                    tx.set_audience_epoch(&table, epoch, now)?;
                }
            }
            let population_changed=tx.activation_population()?.as_deref()==Some("true");
            let rebuild: Vec<_> = schema.maintains.iter().filter(|m| {
                (changed && (population_changed || previous.as_ref().is_none_or(|old| crate::successor::maintain_rebuild_needed(old, schema, m))))
                    || (repair_maintained_ids && m.row_key.is_none())
                    || (repair_live_sums && matches!(m.kind, crate::schema::MaintainKind::Sum { .. }) && schema.table(&m.source).is_some_and(|source| source.is_expiring()))
            }).collect();
            tx.mark_live_sum_candidates()?;
            if needs_maintained_id_marker {
                // This write is inside the activation transaction: a failed
                // rebuild leaves both old rows and the old/missing marker. A
                // first aggregate has no legacy target identity to rewrite,
                // but records the current address function for later opens.
                tx.mark_maintained_ids()?;
            }
            let attribution = recorded::paths_changed(schema, previous.as_ref());
            let columns = column_activation::changed_parents(schema, if population_changed {None} else {previous.as_ref()});
            if rebuild.is_empty() && !attribution && columns.is_empty() && !repair_maintained_ids { return Ok(()); }
            let seq = tx.next_seq()?;
            let phase = std::time::Instant::now();
            if attribution {
                // This runner owns only activation rewrites; ordinary rebuilds
                // below retain their commit and partition accounting.
                let mut capture = Runner::new(tx, schema, Context::system().at(now), Meter::new(Ceilings::unbounded(), Cut::Abort), seq);
                capture.capture_activation(previous.as_ref(), Some(report))?;
                report.detail("capture recorded paths", phase);
                // A newly introduced aggregate has no legacy identity map to
                // preserve. Keep its event-free recorded-path rebuild out of
                // commit accounting, as activation did before the address
                // migration existed.
                if !repair_maintained_ids {
                    capture.rebuild_recorded_activation(previous.as_ref(), &rebuild.iter().copied().filter(|m| m.private.is_none()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), report)?;
                }
            }
            let mut runner = Runner::new(tx, schema, Context::system().at(now), Meter::new(Ceilings::unbounded(), Cut::Abort), seq);
            if repair_maintained_ids {
                let started = std::time::Instant::now();
                let rewritten = runner.rewrite_legacy_maintained_references(&rebuild.iter().copied().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(), previous.as_ref(), Some(tx))?;
                if rewritten != 0 { report.changes.push(format!("rewrote {rewritten} legacy aggregate references")); }
                report.detail("rewrite legacy aggregate references", started);
            }
            // Legacy maps must be captured before any activation rebuild can

//! Release-only storage outside the active row/index namespace.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000#2-retain-by-default — moves, restorations and deletion evidence share activation's transaction.
use super::*;
use crate::schema::{ColumnDefault, ColumnType, materialize_optional_fields};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

pub(crate) const VERSION: &str = "snapback4-release-store-3";

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct Column {
    kind: ColumnType,
    default: Option<ColumnDefault>,
    authoritative: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    capture_source: Option<Table>,
}

pub(crate) fn enable(conn: &Connection) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    conn.execute_batch("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _dormant_narrow_rows(t INTEGER NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,definition TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(t,id)) WITHOUT ROWID;
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _dormant_tables(table_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, definition TEXT NOT NULL);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _dormant_rows(t INTEGER NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(t,id)) WITHOUT ROWID;
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _dormant_columns(table_name TEXT NOT NULL,column_name TEXT NOT NULL,definition TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(table_name,column_name)) WITHOUT ROWID;
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _dormant_values(t INTEGER NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,column_name TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,live_source INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,PRIMARY KEY(t,id,column_name)) WITHOUT ROWID;
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _dormant_indexes(table_name TEXT NOT NULL,index_name TEXT NOT NULL,definition TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(table_name,index_name)) WITHOUT ROWID;
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _dormant_refs(t INTEGER NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,column_name TEXT NOT NULL,parent_t INTEGER NOT NULL,parent_id TEXT NOT NULL,invalid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,PRIMARY KEY(t,id,column_name,parent_t,parent_id)) WITHOUT ROWID;
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS _dormant_parent ON _dormant_refs(parent_t,parent_id);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _release_events(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,at INTEGER NOT NULL,operation TEXT NOT NULL,release INTEGER,previous INTEGER,generation INTEGER NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,summary TEXT NOT NULL);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _release_event_items(event INTEGER NOT NULL,path TEXT NOT NULL,detail TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(event,path)) WITHOUT ROWID;")?;
    if !live_cells_column(conn)? {
        // Published predecessors have captured-only cells. Defaulting them
        // to captured is conservative; shared definitions cannot prove a
        // particular retained cell ever had live authority.
        conn.execute_batch("ALTER TABLE _dormant_values ADD COLUMN live_source INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;")?;
    }
    conn.execute("UPDATE _meta SET value=?1 WHERE key='version' AND value NOT IN ('snapback4-release-store-6','snapback4-release-store-7','snapback4-release-store-8','snapback4-release-store-9','snapback4-release-store-10')", [VERSION])?;
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn live_cells_column(conn:&Connection)->Result<bool,RuntimeError> {
    Ok(conn.query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pragma_table_info('_dormant_values') WHERE name='live_source')",[],|r|r.get(0))?)
}

pub(super) fn enabled(tx: &Tx<'_>) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
    Ok(matches!(tx.meta("version")?.as_deref(),Some(VERSION|"snapback4-release-store-10"|"snapback4-release-store-9"|"snapback4-release-store-8"|"snapback4-release-store-2"|"snapback4-release-store-6"|super::backfills::VERSION)))

//! SQLite access for release, schema and timeline activation.
use super::*;
use crate::activation::{
    ActivationPreparation, ActivationReader, ActivationTransaction, Backend, TimelineWorkReader,
};
use crate::metadata::RestoredPopulation;

impl ActivationReader for Tx<'_> {
    fn opening_backend(&self) -> Result<Backend, RuntimeError> {
        let generation = crate::activation::stored_generation(self.meta("generation")?.as_deref())?;
        self.conn().query_row(
            "SELECT generation, schema, programs FROM _generations WHERE generation = ?1",
            [generation], |row| Ok(Backend(row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?, row.get(2)?)))
            .map_err(|e| RuntimeError::Store(format!("no readable activated backend in this store: {e}")))
    }
    fn check_selected_release(&self, expected: Option<u64>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        Store::check_selected_release(self.conn(), expected)
    }
    fn time_audience_clock(&self) -> Result<i64, RuntimeError> { self.time_audience_clock() }
    fn opening_marker(&self, marker: crate::metadata::SchemaMarker) -> Result<Option<String>, RuntimeError> { self.schema_marker(marker) }
    fn previous_schema(&self) -> Result<Option<String>, RuntimeError> {
        let generation = crate::activation::stored_generation(self.meta("generation")?.as_deref())?;
        Ok(self.conn().query_row("SELECT schema FROM _generations WHERE generation = ?1", [generation], |row| row.get(0)).optional()?)
    }
    fn live_sum_marker(&self) -> Result<Option<String>, RuntimeError> {
        Ok(self
            .conn()
            .query_row(
                "SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key = 'live_sum_candidates'",
                [],
                |row| row.get::<_, String>(0),
            )
            .optional()?)
    }
    fn activation_population(&self) -> Result<Option<String>, RuntimeError> {
        self.meta("activation_population")
    }
    fn narrowed_retained(&self) -> Result<Option<String>, RuntimeError> {
        self.meta("activation_narrowed_retained")
    }
    fn narrowed_restored(&self) -> Result<Option<String>, RuntimeError> {
        self.meta("activation_narrowed_restored")
    }
    fn restored_population(
        &self,
        kind: RestoredPopulation,
        path: &str,
    ) -> Result<Option<String>, RuntimeError> {
        let prefix = match kind {
            RestoredPopulation::Rows => "activation_narrowed_restored",
            RestoredPopulation::Column => "activation_column_restored",
            RestoredPopulation::Table => "activation_table_restored",
        };
        self.meta(&format!("{prefix}:{path}"))
    }
    fn activation_inventory(&self) -> Result<Vec<release_history::DormantItem>, RuntimeError> {
        release_history::inventory(self.conn(), None, usize::MAX)
    }
    fn table_populated(&self, table: &str) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
        Ok(self.conn().query_row(
            "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r JOIN _catalog c ON r.t = c.num WHERE c.name = ?1)",
            [table],
            |row| row.get(0),
        )?)
    }
    fn any_table_image(
        &self,
        table: &str,
        mut survives: impl FnMut(&Value) -> bool,
    ) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
        let mut statement = self
            .conn()
            .prepare("SELECT data FROM r WHERE t = (SELECT num FROM _catalog WHERE name = ?1) ORDER BY id")?;
        let mut rows = statement.query([table])?;
        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {
            let image: Value = crate::json_codec::from_text(
                row.get_ref(0)?
                    .as_str()
                    .map_err(|e| RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?,
            )
            .map_err(|e| RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?;
            if survives(&image) {
                return Ok(true);
            }
        }
        Ok(false)
    }
    fn timeline_rebuild_exists(&self, table: &str, id: &str) -> Result<bool, RuntimeError> {
        Ok(self.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE t = (SELECT num FROM _catalog WHERE name = ?1) AND id = ?2)", [table, id], |row| row.get(0))?)
    }
}

impl ActivationTransaction for Tx<'_> {
    fn set_active_release(&self, release: u64) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.set_meta("release", &release.to_string())
    }
    fn mark_live_sum_candidates(&self) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.set_meta("live_sum_candidates", "1")
    }
    fn mark_maintained_ids(&self) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.set_meta(
            crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META,
            crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_VERSION,
        )
    }
    fn set_audience_epoch(&self, table: &str, epoch: u64, now: i64) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.set_meta(
            &crate::partition::audience_epoch_key(table),
            &epoch.to_string(),
        )?;
        self.set_meta(
            &crate::partition::audience_epoch_time_key(table),
            &now.to_string(),
        )
    }
    fn clear_activation_metadata(&self) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.conn().execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key IN ('activation_restore','activation_population','activation_narrowed_retained','activation_narrowed_restored') OR key LIKE 'activation_narrowed_restored:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_column_restored:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_table_restored:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_table_restored_ids:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_narrowed_restored_ids:%' OR key LIKE 'activation_column_restored_ids:%'",[])?;
        Ok(())
    }
    fn clear_retired_table(&self, table: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.conn().execute(
            "DELETE FROM r WHERE t = (SELECT num FROM _catalog WHERE name = ?1)",
            [table],
        )?;
        Ok(())
    }
    fn clear_retired_index(&self, table: &str, index: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.conn().execute(
            "DELETE FROM i WHERE ti = (SELECT num FROM _catalog WHERE name = ?1)",
            [format!("{table}.{index}")],
        )?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl ActivationPreparation for super::release::ReleaseCheck<'_> {
    fn check_selected_release(&self, expected: Option<u64>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        Store::check_selected_release(self.0, expected)
    }
    fn check_backend(&self, backend: &Backend) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        backend.check(self.0)
    }
    fn activation_inventory(&self) -> Result<Vec<release_history::DormantItem>, RuntimeError> {
        release_history::inventory(self.0, None, usize::MAX)
    }
    fn enable_dormant(&self) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        dormant::enable(self.0)
    }
    fn prepare_release_metadata(
        &self,
        native_digest: &str,
        restore: bool,
        visibility:Option<&crate::engine::release::VisibilityPolicy>,
    ) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.0.execute("INSERT INTO _meta(key,value) VALUES('release_native_digest',?1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value",[native_digest])?;
        self.0.execute("INSERT INTO _meta(key,value) VALUES('activation_restore',?1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value",[if restore {"true"}else{"false"}])?;
        // Registry custody is also new store law: an older CLI must not treat
        // prepared views as ordinary latest releases or skip their policy.
        self.0.execute("UPDATE _meta SET value=?1 WHERE key='version'",[super::table_renames::VERSION])?;
        self.0.execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key='activation_visibility'",[])?;
        if let Some(policy)=visibility {self.0.execute("INSERT INTO _meta(key,value) VALUES('activation_visibility',?1)",[serde_json::to_string(policy).map_err(|e|RuntimeError::Store(e.to_string()))?])?;}

        Ok(())
    }
}

impl TimelineWorkReader for Store {
    fn timeline_work_count(&self, table: &str, state: &str) -> Result<u64, RuntimeError> {
        self.conn().query_row(
            "SELECT count(*) FROM r JOIN _catalog c ON r.t = c.num WHERE c.name = ?1 AND CASE WHEN json_valid(r.data) THEN json_extract(r.data, '$.Row.status.String') END = ?2",
            [table, state], |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0).map(|n| n as u64)).map_err(RuntimeError::from)
    }
}

import type { Session } from "./auth.ts";
import { isReadToken } from "./read-token.ts";

/** Authenticated development and staging return this exact bearer's current live lifetime.
 * Matching the dispatch bearer is the caller's responsibility. Same-bearer
 * preservation is monotonic, so a delayed old reply cannot undo a jump. */
export function reconciledTiming(session: Session, response: Response): Session {
  if (response.headers.get("x-snapback-session-timing") !== "staging") return session;
  const expiry = Number(response.headers.get("x-snapback-session-expires"));
  const capText = response.headers.get("x-snapback-session-cap");
  const cap = capText === null ? undefined : Number(capText);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(expiry) || expiry <= 0) return session;
  const read = isReadToken(session.token);
  if (read && (cap === undefined || !Number.isSafeInteger(cap) || cap < expiry)) return session;
  if (!read && cap !== undefined) return session;
  const expiresAt = Math.max(session.expiresAt, expiry);
  const capExpiresAt = cap === undefined ? undefined : Math.max(session.capExpiresAt ?? 0, cap);
  if (expiresAt === session.expiresAt && capExpiresAt === session.capExpiresAt) return session;
  return { ...session, expiresAt, ...(capExpiresAt === undefined ? {} : { capExpiresAt }) };
}

export function requestMatchesSession(request: { url: string; authorization: string | null }, base: string, session: Session): boolean {
  return (request.url === base || request.url.startsWith(base + "/")) && request.authorization === `Bearer ${session.token}`;
}

/** Expired local metadata may be superseded by a preserving development or staging jump.
 * Read-only probing creates no session and never widens or refreshes one. */
export async function restoreStagingTiming(base: string, session: Session, fetcher: typeof fetch): Promise<Session | null> {
  const aborter = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => aborter.abort(), 10_000);
  (timer as { unref?: () => void }).unref?.();
  try {
    const response = await fetcher(`${base}/probe?scope=1`, { headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${session.token}` }, signal: aborter.signal });
    if (!response.ok) return null;
    const next = reconciledTiming(session, response);
    const stamp = Number(response.headers.get("x-snapback-time"));
    if (next === session || !Number.isSafeInteger(stamp) || next.expiresAt <= stamp) return null;
    // Consume the bounded ordinary probe body before blessing restoration.
    const { readResponse } = await import("./http-response.ts");
    const body = await readResponse(response);
    return body.ok === true && body.viewer === session.principal && body.scope === (isReadToken(session.token) ? "read" : "full") ? next : null;
  } catch { return null; }
  finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}

//! SQLite erases booleans to integers. Recover direct column types from the
//! adopted schema and SQL projection, never by guessing from names or 0/1.
// @ref LLP 3000.007#20.26 — positional JSON stays compatible; boolean recovery is presentation on the operator's adopted snapshot.
// @ref LLP 3000.000.000.002#10-wave-25-day-two-friction-dx8 — direct schema-proven media cells use their ordinary wire JSON in object rows.
use snapback4_core::{inspection::InspectionColumnKind as Kind, schema::{ColumnType, Schema}};
use sqlparser::{ast::{Expr, ObjectName, Query, SelectItem, SelectItemQualifiedWildcardKind, SetExpr, Statement, TableFactor}, dialect::SQLiteDialect, parser::Parser};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

type Columns = Vec<(String, Kind)>;
type Tables = BTreeMap<String, Columns>;

pub(super) fn kinds(sql: &str, schema: &Schema, count: usize, retained: bool) -> Result<Vec<Kind>, String> {
    let mut tables: Tables = schema.visible_tables().map(|(name, table)| {
        let mut columns = vec![("id".into(), Kind::Plain)];
        columns.extend(table.columns.iter().filter(|(name, _)| *name != "id")
            .map(|(name, kind)| (name.to_ascii_lowercase(), if matches!(kind.required(), ColumnType::Bool) { Kind::Bool } else if kind.contains_asset() { Kind::Media } else { Kind::Plain })));
        if retained {columns.extend([("_snapback_state".into(),Kind::Plain),("_snapback_source".into(),Kind::Plain),("_snapback_columns".into(),Kind::Plain)]);}
        (name.to_ascii_lowercase(), columns)
    }).collect();
    let statements = Parser::parse_sql(&SQLiteDialect {}, sql).map_err(|e| format!("--json-objects SQL projection: {e}; use --json for SQLite-specific syntax"))?;
    let [Statement::Query(query)] = statements.as_slice() else { return Err("--json-objects takes a SELECT".into()); };
    let columns = query_columns(query, &mut tables)?;
    if columns.len() != count { return Err("--json-objects cannot determine this projection's column types; select explicit columns or use --json".into()); }
    Ok(columns.into_iter().map(|(_, kind)| kind).collect())
}

fn name(name: &ObjectName) -> Option<String> {
    // SQLite schema qualification bypasses CTE shadowing; do not erase it.
    if name.0.len() != 1 { return None; }
    name.0.last()?.as_ident().map(|id| id.value.to_ascii_lowercase())
}

fn query_columns(query: &Query, inherited: &mut Tables) -> Result<Columns, String> {
    let mut tables = inherited.clone();
    if let Some(with) = &query.with {
        if with.recursive { return Err("--json-objects does not infer recursive CTE types; use --json".into()); }
        for cte in &with.cte_tables {
            if tables.contains_key(&cte.alias.name.value.to_ascii_lowercase()) {
                return Err("--json-objects does not infer shadowing CTEs; use --json".into());
            }
            let mut columns = query_columns(&cte.query, &mut tables)?;
            for (column, alias) in columns.iter_mut().zip(&cte.alias.columns) { column.0 = alias.name.value.to_ascii_lowercase(); }
            tables.insert(cte.alias.name.value.to_ascii_lowercase(), columns);
        }
    }
    set_columns(&query.body, &mut tables)
}

fn relation(factor: &TableFactor, tables: &mut Tables) -> Result<(String, Columns), String> {
    match factor {
        TableFactor::Table { name: object, alias, args: None, .. } => {
            let key = name(object).ok_or("--json-objects does not infer schema-qualified relations; use --json")?;
            let columns = tables.get(&key).ok_or("--json-objects needs application tables or typed CTEs")?.clone();
            Ok((alias.as_ref().map(|a| a.name.value.to_ascii_lowercase()).unwrap_or(key), columns))
        }
        TableFactor::Derived { subquery, alias, .. } => Ok((alias.as_ref().map(|a| a.name.value.to_ascii_lowercase()).unwrap_or_default(), query_columns(subquery, tables)?)),
        _ => Err("--json-objects cannot infer this table expression; use --json".into()),
    }
}

fn set_columns(body: &SetExpr, tables: &mut Tables) -> Result<Columns, String> {
    match body {
        SetExpr::Query(q) => query_columns(q, tables),
        SetExpr::SetOperation { left, right, .. } => {
            let mut left = set_columns(left, tables)?;
            let right = set_columns(right, tables)?;
            if left.len() != right.len() { return Err("incompatible SQL projections".into()); }
            for (l, r) in left.iter_mut().zip(right) { if l.1 != r.1 { l.1 = Kind::Plain; } }
            Ok(left)
        }
        SetExpr::Select(select) => {
            let mut sources = Vec::new();
            for from in &select.from {
                sources.push(relation(&from.relation, tables)?);
                for join in &from.joins { sources.push(relation(&join.relation, tables)?); }
            }
            let mut output = Vec::new();
            for item in &select.projection {
                match item {
                    SelectItem::Wildcard(_) => output.extend(sources.iter().flat_map(|(_, cols)| cols.clone())),
                    SelectItem::QualifiedWildcard(SelectItemQualifiedWildcardKind::ObjectName(object), _) => {
                        let key = name(object).ok_or("unsupported wildcard")?;
                        let (_, cols) = sources.iter().find(|(alias, _)| *alias == key).ok_or("unknown wildcard table")?;
                        output.extend(cols.clone());
                    }
                    SelectItem::UnnamedExpr(expr) => {
                        let mut direct = expr;
                        while let Expr::Nested(inner) = direct { direct = inner; }
                        let label = match direct {
                            Expr::Identifier(id) => id.value.clone(),
                            Expr::CompoundIdentifier(ids) => ids.last().unwrap().value.clone(),
                            _ => expr.to_string(),
                        };
                        output.push((label.to_ascii_lowercase(), kind(expr, &sources)));
                    }
                    SelectItem::ExprWithAlias { expr, alias } => output.push((alias.value.to_ascii_lowercase(), kind(expr, &sources))),
                    _ => return Err("unsupported object-row projection; use --json".into()),
                }
            }
            let mut names = BTreeSet::new();
            if output.iter().any(|(name, _)| !names.insert(name)) {
                return Err("--json-objects needs unique names in every projection; alias duplicate columns".into());
            }
            Ok(output)
        }
        _ => Err("--json-objects needs a SELECT projection; use --json".into()),
    }
}

fn kind(expr: &Expr, sources: &[(String, Columns)]) -> Kind {
    let (table, column) = match expr {
        Expr::Nested(expr) => return kind(expr, sources),
        Expr::Identifier(id) => (None, &id.value),
        Expr::CompoundIdentifier(ids) if ids.len() == 2 => (Some(ids[0].value.to_ascii_lowercase()), &ids[1].value),
        _ => return Kind::Plain, // Computed SQL expressions retain SQLite's own types.
    };
    let found: Vec<Kind> = sources.iter().filter(|(alias, _)| table.as_ref().is_none_or(|t| t == alias))
        .flat_map(|(_, cols)| cols.iter().filter(|(name, _)| name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(column)).map(|(_, kind)| *kind)).collect();
    // An unqualified duplicate only reaches execution when SQLite resolved it
    // through USING/NATURAL. All contributors must agree before typing it bool.
    found.first().copied().filter(|first| found.iter().all(|kind| kind == first)).unwrap_or(Kind::Plain)
}

fn int_range(kind: &ColumnType) -> bool {
    match kind {
        ColumnType::IntRange { .. } => true,
        ColumnType::Optional(inner) | ColumnType::List { of: inner, .. } | ColumnType::ListRange { of: inner, .. } => int_range(inner),
        _ => false,
    }
}

fn ordered_units(table: &Table, rule: &RuleExpr) -> bool {
    let units = |term: &RuleTerm| matches!(term, RuleTerm::Field(f) if matches!(table.columns.get(f), Some(ColumnType::Decimal { .. } | ColumnType::Money { .. })));
    match rule {
        RuleExpr::Compare(_, l, r) => units(l) || units(r),
        RuleExpr::And(items) | RuleExpr::Or(items) => items.iter().any(|item| ordered_units(table, item)),
        RuleExpr::Not(inner) => ordered_units(table, inner),
        _ => false,
    }
}

fn ordered(rule: &RuleExpr) -> bool {
    match rule {
        RuleExpr::Compare(..) => true,
        RuleExpr::And(items) | RuleExpr::Or(items) => items.iter().any(ordered),
        RuleExpr::Not(inner) => ordered(inner),
        _ => false,
    }
}

impl SessionClockTransaction for Tx<'_> {
    fn clock_sessions(&self, read: bool, after: Option<&str>) -> Result<Vec<ClockSession>, RuntimeError> {
        if read && !super::identity::present(self.conn())? { return Ok(Vec::new()); }
        let sql = if read {
            "SELECT token_digest,created_at FROM _read_sessions WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR token_digest > ?1) ORDER BY token_digest LIMIT ?2"
        } else {
            "SELECT token_digest,created_at FROM _sessions WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR token_digest > ?1) AND COALESCE(family,token_digest) NOT IN (SELECT value FROM _meta WHERE key = 'worker:session-family' UNION SELECT substr(key,15) FROM _meta WHERE key LIKE 'worker:family:%') ORDER BY token_digest LIMIT ?2"
        };
        Ok(self.conn().prepare_cached(sql)?.query_map(params![after, PAGE as i64], |r| Ok(ClockSession { digest: r.get(0)?, created_at: r.get(1)? }))?.collect::<Result<_, _>>()?)
    }
    fn set_clock_session(&self, digest: &str, scope: SessionScope, created_at: i64, expires_at: i64, cap: Option<i64>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        match scope {
            SessionScope::Full => { self.conn().execute("UPDATE _sessions SET created_at = ?2, expires_at = ?3 WHERE token_digest = ?1", params![digest,created_at,expires_at])?; }
            SessionScope::Read => { self.conn().execute("UPDATE _read_sessions SET created_at = ?2, expires_at = ?3, cap_expires_at = ?4 WHERE token_digest = ?1", params![digest,created_at,expires_at,cap])?; }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    fn clock_mints(&self, after: Option<(&str, &str)>) -> Result<Vec<ClockMint>, RuntimeError> {
        let scope: bool = self.conn().query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pragma_table_info('_session_mint_bindings') WHERE name = 'scope')", [], |r| r.get(0))?;
        let sql = if scope {
            "SELECT invocation,intent,principal,family,principal_generation,expires_at FROM _session_mint_bindings WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR (invocation,intent) > (?1,?2)) AND scope = 'full' ORDER BY invocation,intent LIMIT ?3"
        } else {
            "SELECT invocation,intent,principal,family,principal_generation,expires_at FROM _session_mint_bindings WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR (invocation,intent) > (?1,?2)) ORDER BY invocation,intent LIMIT ?3"
        };
        Ok(self.conn().prepare_cached(sql)?.query_map(params![after.map(|a| a.0),after.map(|a| a.1), PAGE as i64], |r| Ok(ClockMint { invocation: r.get(0)?,intent: r.get(1)?,principal: r.get(2)?,family: r.get(3)?,generation: r.get(4)?,expires_at: r.get(5)? }))?.collect::<Result<_, _>>()?)
    }
    fn set_clock_mint(&self, invocation: &str, intent: &str, expires_at: i64) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.conn().execute("UPDATE _session_mint_bindings SET expires_at = ?3 WHERE invocation = ?1 AND intent = ?2", params![invocation,intent,expires_at])?;

//! The list-to-child migration owns actual asset homes across edited cycles.
use super::*;
const OLD_EACH: &str = "table orders:\n  names: [file <=1000] <=8\n  public 'fixture'\n  insert <- allow\n  update <- allow\n  online only\nmutation add(names: [file <=1000] <=8):\n  return insert orders {names}\nmutation edit(id: orders, names: [file <=1000] <=8):\n  return update orders[id] {names}\n";

fn handle(e: &mut Engine, text: &[u8]) -> Value {
    let asset = e
        .store_file("alice", text, Some("text/plain"), "names.txt", 100)
        .unwrap();
    Value::Map(BTreeMap::from([("id".into(), Value::Id(asset.id))]).into())
}
fn mutate(
    e: &mut Engine,
    op: &str,
    args: impl IntoIterator<Item = (&'static str, Value)>,
) -> Value {
    let r = e
        .mutate(
            op,
            None,
            Context::new(
                "alice",
                args.into_iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.into(), v)).collect(),
            )
            .at(101),
        )
        .unwrap();
    match r.state {
        WriteState::Sent { result, .. } => result,
        _ => panic!("{r:?}"),
    }
}
fn child_for(e: &Engine, asset: &str) -> String {
    let home = e.store().asset(asset).unwrap().unwrap().home.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(home.0, "documents");
    home.1
}
fn ids(e: &mut Engine, parent: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let list = field(e, "orders", parent, "names");
    let Value::Array(values) = list else {
        panic!("{list:?}")
    };
    values
        .iter()
        .map(|v| crate::assets::asset_id(Some(v)).unwrap().to_owned())
        .collect()
}
#[test]
fn dx8_each_moves_each_element_and_keeps_edited_and_native_children_through_cycles() {
fn dx8_each_preserves_optional_null_and_narrows_removed_old_list_elements() {
    let optional = OLD_EACH.replace("names: [file <=1000] <=8", "names: [file <=1000] <=8 ?");
    let mut e = engine(&optional);
    let parent = mutate(&mut e, "add", [("names", Value::Null)])
        .field("id")
        .unwrap()
        .as_str()
        .unwrap()
        .to_owned();
    adopt(&mut e, NEW_EACH, 2).unwrap();
    adopt(&mut e, &optional, 1).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(field(&mut e, "orders", &parent, "names"), Value::Null);
    let mut e = engine(OLD_EACH);
    let a = handle(&mut e, b"a");
    let b = handle(&mut e, b"b");
    let parent = mutate(&mut e, "add", [("names", Value::Array(vec![a, b]))])
        .field("id")
        .unwrap()
        .as_str()
        .unwrap()
        .to_owned();
    adopt(&mut e, NEW_EACH, 2).unwrap();
    adopt(&mut e, OLD_EACH, 1).unwrap();
    let Value::Array(mut values) = field(&mut e, "orders", &parent, "names") else {
        panic!()
    };
    let removed = values.pop().unwrap();
    let removed_id = crate::assets::asset_id(Some(&removed)).unwrap().to_owned();
    mutate(
        &mut e,
        "edit",
        [("id", Value::Id(parent)), ("names", Value::Array(values))],
    );
    adopt(&mut e, NEW_EACH, 2).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        e.store().count("documents").unwrap(),
        1,
        "removed element cannot regain an active asset home"
    );
    for _ in 0..3 {
        adopt(&mut e, OLD_EACH, 1).unwrap();
        adopt(&mut e, NEW_EACH, 2).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(e.store().count("documents").unwrap(), 1);
        let released = e.store().asset(&removed_id).unwrap().unwrap();
        assert!(released.home.is_none(), "removed asset must have no active home after repeated migration cycles");
        assert!(released.released_at.is_some(), "removed asset remains eligible for ordinary garbage collection");
    }
}

#[test]
fn dx8_each_restores_suspended_children_without_replaying_consumed_lists() {
    let suspended=NEW_EACH.split("\ntable documents:").next().unwrap().to_owned()+"\nmutation add():\n  return insert orders {}\n";
    let mut e=engine(OLD_EACH);
    let a=handle(&mut e,b"original");
    let parent=mutate(&mut e,"add",[("names",Value::Array(vec![a]))]).field("id").unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_owned();
    adopt(&mut e,NEW_EACH,2).unwrap();
    let image=handle(&mut e,b"edited current");let aid=crate::assets::asset_id(Some(&image)).unwrap().to_owned();
    let child=e.store().test_support_conn().query_row("SELECT id FROM r WHERE t=(SELECT num FROM _catalog WHERE name='documents')",[],|r|r.get::<_,String>(0)).unwrap();
    mutate(&mut e,"edit",[("id",Value::Id(child.clone())),("names",image)]);
    let native=handle(&mut e,b"native current");let bid=crate::assets::asset_id(Some(&native)).unwrap().to_owned();
    let native=mutate(&mut e,"attach",[("order",Value::Id(parent.clone())),("names",native)]).field("id").unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_owned();
    for cycle in 0..3 {
        adopt(&mut e,&suspended,3).unwrap();
        if cycle==0 {mutate(&mut e,"add",[]);}
        adopt(&mut e,NEW_EACH,2).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(e.store().count("documents").unwrap(),2);
        assert_eq!(child_for(&e,&aid),child);assert_eq!(child_for(&e,&bid),native);
        assert!(e.store().adoption_report().backfills.iter().any(|x|x.contains("without replaying consumed")));
    }
    adopt(&mut e,OLD_EACH,1).unwrap();assert_eq!(ids(&mut e,&parent),vec![aid,bid]);
    adopt(&mut e,NEW_EACH,2).unwrap();assert_eq!(e.store().count("documents").unwrap(),2);
}
#[test]
fn dx8_each_resume_refuses_retrospective_native_capture_and_unknown_sources() {
    let mut e=engine(OLD_EACH);let a=handle(&mut e,b"known");
    let parent=mutate(&mut e,"add",[("names",Value::Array(vec![a]))]).field("id").unwrap().as_str().unwrap().to_owned();
    adopt(&mut e,NEW_EACH,2).unwrap();
    let without=NEW_EACH.lines().filter(|s|!s.starts_with("extract ")).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n")+"\n";
    adopt(&mut e,&without,3).unwrap();
    let b=handle(&mut e,b"independent");mutate(&mut e,"attach",[("order",Value::Id(parent)),("names",b)]);
    let generation=e.generation();let error=adopt(&mut e,NEW_EACH,2).unwrap_err().to_string();
    assert!(error.contains("retrospectively capture"),"{error}");assert_eq!(e.generation(),generation);
    let only_parent=NEW_EACH.split("\ntable documents:").next().unwrap().to_owned()+"\nmutation add():\n  return insert orders {}\n";
    let mut e=engine(&only_parent);mutate(&mut e,"add",[]);
    let generation=e.generation();let error=adopt(&mut e,NEW_EACH,2).unwrap_err().to_string();
    assert!(error.contains("no successfully applied extraction"),"{error}");assert_eq!(e.generation(),generation);
    // An initially empty new-shape backend can own the declaration, then
    // suspend and resume native rows under the same captured lifetime law.
    let mut e=engine(NEW_EACH);
    adopt(&mut e,&only_parent,3).unwrap();adopt(&mut e,NEW_EACH,2).unwrap();
}

//! One charge path for every fixed source-write reservation.
// @ref LLP 3000.022#14.3 — projection retains prices, never private formulas.
use super::runner::Runner;
use crate::{error::{MeterKind, RuntimeError}, schema::reservations::{self, Price}};
impl Runner<'_> {
    pub(super) fn source_price(&self, source: &str, phase: usize) -> Result<Price, RuntimeError> {
        let plan = self.schema.write_reservation(source);
        #[cfg(feature = "sqlite")]
        let plan = if self.device { plan } else { reservations::reservation(self.schema, source) };
        let plan = plan.filter(|p| phase != reservations::VIEW_READ || p.view_read.is_some());
        plan.map(|p| p.price(phase)).ok_or_else(|| RuntimeError::Prediction(
            format!("{source} has no complete source-write reservation; adopt the current backend")))
    }
    pub(super) fn charge_price(&mut self, price: Price) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        // A failed scratch reservation must not report unallocated heap.
        if !self.meter.room(MeterKind::HeapBytes, price[4]) {
            return Err(RuntimeError::Bound { kind: MeterKind::HeapBytes,
                actual: self.meter.used.heap_bytes.saturating_add(price[4]),
                ceiling: self.meter.ceilings.heap_bytes, site: self.meter.site().into() });
        }
        for (kind, amount) in [MeterKind::Steps, MeterKind::IndexEntries, MeterKind::Examined,
            MeterKind::RowsWritten, MeterKind::HeapBytes, MeterKind::OutputBytes, MeterKind::RuleProbes]
            .into_iter().zip(price) { self.meter.charge(kind, amount)?; }
        Ok(())
    }
    #[cfg(feature = "sqlite")]
    pub(super) fn reserve_assets(&mut self, table: &crate::schema::Table) -> Result<u64, RuntimeError> {
        if !table.columns.values().any(crate::schema::ColumnType::contains_asset) { return Ok(0); }
        if !self.device && !self.tx.holds_assets()? { return Ok(0); }
        let price = reservations::asset_price(table);
        self.charge_price(price)?;
        Ok(price[4])
    }
}

    fn delete_attempt(&mut self, table_name: &str, id: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.refuse_engine_owned(table_name, Effect::Delete)?;
        self.refuse_receipt_scope_delete(table_name)?;
        let table = self.schema.table(table_name).ok_or_else(|| RuntimeError::Schema(format!("missing table {table_name}")))?;
        self.reserve_write_rules(table, &[Effect::Read, Effect::Delete])?;
        // @ref LLP 3000.007#20.9 — delete prepays hidden contribution work before fetching its old image, with the same attempt lifetime as update.
        self.reserve_maintains(table_name, table)?;
        let Some(old) = self.metered_scan(|runner, allowance| {
            runner.fetch_write_target(allowance, table_name, id)
        })? else {
            return Err(RuntimeError::Require { site: Some(self.statement_site.clone()), code: "NOT_FOUND".to_owned(), message: None });
        };
        // @ref LLP 3000.039#3 — a delete that consults referencing rows needs read authority on its row first.
        let readable =
            !self.inactive_write_target(table_name, &old)? && self.check_rule(table_name, Effect::Read, None, &old)?;
        if (self.schema.children(table_name).next().is_some() || self.schema.is_referenced(table_name)) && !readable
        {
            self.refusing_clause(table_name, "read rule");
            return Err(self.no_write_target());
        }
        if !self.check_rule(table_name, Effect::Delete, None, &old)? {
            return Err(if readable {
                RuntimeError::Rule { table: table_name.to_owned(), effect: Effect::Delete }
            } else { self.no_write_target() });
        }
        self.delete_authorized(table_name, old)
    }

    pub(super) fn delete_authorized(&mut self, table_name: &str, old: Value) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        let old = if self.schema.is_referenced(table_name) {
            self.apply_reference_actions(table_name, &old)?;
            // @ref LLP 3000.039#3 — the actions may have changed the root (a maintained column mirrored from its children): remove its current image.
            let id = old.field("id")?.as_str()?.to_owned();
            self.metered_scan(|runner, allowance| runner.tx.get(allowance, table_name, &id))?.unwrap_or(old)
        } else { old };
        self.delete_row(table_name, old)
    }

// Add a capability and its schema predicate here in one line. This is both
    fn serialize<S: Serializer>(&self, serializer: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error> {
        let required = self.required_capabilities();
        // The derive's field order, omissions and bytes are unchanged for
        // ordinary schemas, including the serialized conformance corpus.
        if required.is_empty() { return Wire::serialize(self, serializer); }
        let mut wire = self.clone();
        for table in wire.tables.values_mut() {
            table.constraints.retain(|c| !matches!(c, Constraint::Recorded));
        }
        let mut carrier = wire.tables.first_entry().ok_or_else(||
            serde::ser::Error::custom("E_SCHEMA_CAPABILITY: required capabilities need a table carrier"))?;
        carrier.get_mut().constraints.push(Constraint::Capabilities(required));
        Wire::serialize(&wire, serializer)
    }
}
